Our members have cumulatively increased their Gross Profits by almost $3.0 Billion dollars through the ATI program.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Member Relations Manager serves as ATI’s proactive voice of the member, identifying concerns early, coordinating timely solutions and helping prevent member attrition. Reporting to the General Manager, Member Programs, this role spends the majority of its time engaging directly with members, gathering feedback, resolving issues and closing the loop. The Manager owns ATI’s voice of member survey programs and translates recurring feedback into recommendations and programmatic improvements. This role partners closely with Coaching, Training, Peer Groups, Partnership Programs and other ATI teams to create a more responsive, consistent member experience.

Areas of Responsibility

  • Build and maintain a consistent outbound member-engagement cadence, proactively contacting members to understand their experience, surface concerns and identify emerging risks.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for member concerns, listening carefully, documenting the issue, assessing urgency and coordinating a clear path to resolution.
  • Own ATI’s voice of member survey programs, including survey planning, deployment, response follow-up, insight reporting and continuous improvement of the feedback process.
  • Track member issues, commitments and follow-up actions in detail, ensuring members receive timely updates and every concern is carried through to closure.
  • Identify patterns across individual member feedback and recommend programmatic, process or service changes when issues affect multiple members.
  • Partner with Coaching, Training, Peer Groups and Partnership Programs to resolve member needs and strengthen the consistency of the overall member experience.
  • Build productive relationships across ATI and with external partners to remove barriers, coordinate solutions and ensure accountability for member commitments.
  • Create clear reporting on member sentiment, recurring issues, attrition risks, resolution progress and opportunities for improvement.
  • Escalate high-risk or unresolved concerns to the General Manager, Member Programs with relevant context, recommended actions and a defined follow-up plan.
  • Represent ATI with energy, empathy and credibility in every member interaction, reinforcing confidence that concerns are heard, owned and acted upon.

Success Measures

  • Earlier identification and resolution of member concerns before they become deal breakers or lead to attrition.
  • Consistent, high-quality outbound member engagement and timely follow-up on feedback, commitments and open issues.
  • Improved member satisfaction, confidence, retention and perception of ATI’s responsiveness.
  • Clear voice of member insights that result in measurable program, process and service improvements.
  • Strong cross-functional accountability, issue ownership and closed-loop communication across ATI’s member-facing teams.

Candidate Profile

  • 8+ years of experience in member relations, customer success, account management, client services or retention-focused roles, with a deep understanding of the small business and owner-operator mindset.
  • 5+ years of experience in the automotive industry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and judgment to lead frequent outbound calls, navigate difficult conversations and build trust quickly.
  • Highly extroverted, positive and energetic, with a genuine interest in spending the majority of each day talking with members and seeking candid feedback.
  • Exceptional organization, attention to detail, follow-up and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple issues, commitments and stakeholders without losing momentum.
  • Self-sufficient and comfortable working remotely, setting priorities, taking initiative and moving issues forward with limited day-to-day direction.
  • Strong relationship-building and cross-functional influence skills, with the ability to create productive internal partnerships at ATI and external relationships with partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to convert individual feedback into broader insights, root-cause analysis and practical recommendations that improve programs, processes and member retention.

Franchise Development Support

Leasing & Property Support

  • Follow up with suppliers and contractors regarding outstanding documentation and project actions.

General / Shared Support

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with a range of stakeholders.

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

Cayenta, a division of Harris; is seeking a Consulting Manager who will lead Cayenta CIS software implementation and professional services engagements from inception through go-live and stabilization.

This role manages a team of Application Consultants (AppCons) delivering utility and municipal customer information system (CIS) implementations - spanning billing, customer service, field operations, and integrations with adjacent systems such as Customer Self-Service Portal), MWM (mobile workforce management), and ERP/financial systems. This role drives delivery methodology, provides solution oversight, ensures projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, and maintains high client satisfaction across the utility and municipal client base.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 50%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.

Salary:

90K - 100K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

Team Leadership, Mentorship & Resource Optimization

  • Lead, mentor, and coach Application Consultants (AppCons) and project resources across all consulting tiers to achieve project and business unit objectives.
  • Provide solution oversight across multiple concurrent Cayenta CIS implementations and mentor all consultants within that portfolio, with the goal of enhancing consultant skills to deliver the best possible project outcomes.
  • Allocate and balance AppCon resources across concurrent client engagements, optimizing utilization and billable ratios while preventing burnout - particularly during peak go-live and cutover periods.
  • Foster an agile, accountable team culture focused on problem-solving, continuous learning, and career growth within the Cayenta consulting tier structure.
  • Assist functional managers with mid-year and year-end performance evaluations (e.g., formal feedback through Workday).
  • Monitor overall team performance by tracking and analyzing statistics and trends (utilization, billability, ticket/incident volume in CayStone), providing reporting to the senior Management Team.

Implementation Methodology & Execution

  • Drive standard, repeatable delivery frameworks - including Cayenta's fit-to-standard configuration approach, pre-configured utility/municipal industry templates, and training-first user adoption - rather than defaulting to custom, waterfall-style delays.
  • Lead the effort on complex or "greenfield" CIS solutions and custom modifications on projects or in new markets (e.g., new utility types, new regulatory/rate environments, first-time integrations).
  • Review proposed solution architecture - including CIS configuration, integration design (CSS Portal, MWM, Financial Systems, AMI/MDM, IVR), and data conversion approach - for projects under their purview; able to influence internal and client resources when difficult decisions need to be made.
  • Own and drive continuous improvement of Cayenta's implementation methodology - evaluate what is and isn't working across active projects, partner with Directors on formal changes, revise methodology as agreed, update documentation, and train staff.
  • Lead client workshops to explain the Cayenta CIS product and gather requirements for configuration or customization as required.
  • Partner across departments (including Project Managers) to ensure smooth sales-to-services handoffs and seamless post-go-live transitions to Customer Support.
  • Conduct post-implementation retrospective summaries and coordinate handoffs per standard Cayenta methodology.

Financial & Budget Oversight

  • Establish, track, and manage Cayenta CIS implementation project budgets, cost estimations, and allocations.
  • Monitor project health, milestone completion, expected go-lives, and variance reporting to support monthly Estimate to Complete (ETC) aligned with percentage of completion (POC), in coordination with Finance.

Client Engagement & Escalation Management

  • Positively contribute to client relationship management with utility and municipal clients; coach project resources on good client relationship management (CRM) practices.
  • Maintain regular, transparent communication with executive sponsors (e.g., client VPs, Directors, CFOs/Controllers) and client steering committees, providing consistent status updates.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks (e.g., data conversion issues, integration defects, rate/billing configuration gaps), conduct mitigation planning (including implementation "pre-mortems"), coordinate change control documentation, and resolve client escalations swiftly.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships across the utility/municipal client portfolio.

Knowledge Sharing & Training

  • Apply broad knowledge across numerous Cayenta CIS client implementations and configurations to new situations - essentially "has seen it all" across utility and municipal deployments.
  • Be highly involved in planning and delivering internal training sessions for other Cayenta consultants, as well as the Harris user conference (as requested).

Operational Modernization & Efficiency

  • Champion modern, AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, etc.) to streamline administrative burdens - such as Statement of Work drafting, status report generation, test case documentation, meeting summaries, and variance analysis - enabling the team to focus on proactive client delivery and strategic relationship management.
  • Develop and implement best practices, standards, and processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness of the Cayenta professional services team.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in a professional services or consulting role, ideally within utility/municipal software implementations (CIS, billing, customer service, or related ERP/EAM systems).
  • 4+ years of experience in a senior/managing consultant role, with a track record across 4 or more complex CIS implementation projects (or 20+ successful upgrades) - or 2+ years of formal leadership experience for candidates coming from a people-management track.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software implementation projects for utility or municipal clients.
  • Working knowledge of the utility customer-to-cash lifecycle (meter-to-cash, billing, collections, customer service) and/or public sector implementation environments.
  • Financial Acumen: Demonstrated capability in managing project P&L, budget forecasting, consultant utilization, and contract scope control.
  • Methodologies & Tools: Practical knowledge of software implementation methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid); experience with PSA/project and test management tools (e.g., Jira, CayStone/SpiraTest, ServiceNow, Power BI, Excel).
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage executive client relationships and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.

What would make you stand out:

  • Direct experience with Cayenta CIS or comparable utility/municipal CIS platforms.
  • Familiarity with adjacent Cayenta ecosystem products (SilverBlaze customer self-service portal, MWM mobile workforce management) and common client-side integrations (IFS, AMI/MDM, IVR, print/lockbox vendors).
  • Familiarity with modern productivity and AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI assistants) for reporting, plan generation, status reports, and workflow acceleration.
  • Comfort exploring and adopting new AI-enabled workflows to improve service delivery efficiency.

What we can offer:

  • 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
  • Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
  • Lifestyle rewards
  • Remote work and more!

About Cayenta:

Cayenta is a leading provider of enterprise resource management solutions in the local government, utility and financial industries. Cayenta’s products, services and customer relationships provide the foundation for continued innovation and growth.

About Harris:

Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

Controller Job Description

Company: Pro Coffee Gear
Location: Remote (Global)
Employment Type: Full-time

About Us

Pro Coffee Gear is a rapidly growing e-commerce company specializing in espresso machines and related parts. Our passion for coffee drives us to provide top-tier products and exceptional customer service to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. With a dedication to quality and innovation, we aim to elevate the coffee experience for our customers and become a leading authority in the industry. As a dynamic and diverse team, we value collaboration, creativity, and continuous improvement, and we're committed to fostering a positive and inclusive work environment where everyone can thrive.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Controller to join our leadership team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in financial management, reporting, and analysis, with the ability to drive financial strategy and provide executive-level insights to support business growth and decision-making.

Responsibilities

Financial Management & Reporting

  • Oversee all aspects of financial operations including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Payroll management
  • Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes with accuracy and timeliness
  • Prepare and present comprehensive financial statements, management reports, and board-level presentations
  • Develop and maintain robust financial controls, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance and accuracy

Strategic Analysis & Planning

  • Provide strategic financial analysis and recommendations to executive leadership
  • Lead annual budgeting and forecasting processes, including variance analysis and performance metrics
  • Develop sophisticated financial models and pro forma analyses for business initiatives, product launches, and strategic investments
  • Conduct profitability analysis by product line, customer segment, and business unit

Systems Integration & Process Optimization

  • Ensure seamless integration of inventory management, e-commerce platforms, and payment systems with the general ledger
  • Lead ERP system optimization and financial system implementations
  • Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) and financial dashboards

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Manage relationships with external auditors, tax professionals, and regulatory bodies
  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP, tax regulations, and reporting requirements
  • Oversee internal controls and SOX compliance (if applicable)
  • Identify and mitigate financial risks across the organization

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and mentor finance team members, fostering professional growth and development
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, sales, marketing, and executive teams
  • Provide financial training and support to non-finance departments

Requirements

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required
  • CPA certification strongly preferred
  • Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or MBA preferred

Experience

  • Minimum 7-10 years of progressive accounting and finance experience
  • At least 3-5 years in a Controller or senior financial management role
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail, or inventory-based businesses strongly preferred
  • Public accounting experience with Big 4 or mid-tier firms is a plus

Technical Skills

  • Advanced expertise in Excel, Google Sheets, and financial modeling
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite, QuickBooks Enterprise, SAP, etc.)
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems
  • Strong understanding of business intelligence and reporting tools

Core Competencies

  • Deep understanding of US GAAP and IFRS accounting principles
  • Comprehensive knowledge of US tax system, regulations, and reporting deadlines
  • Proven track record of successful month-end and year-end close processes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
  • Experience in process improvement and change management
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for executive-level reporting

Work Requirements

  • Must align with Central Time business hours for collaboration with US-based team
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, remote environment with minimal supervision
  • Strong project management skills and ability to handle multiple priorities

Benefits

  • Opportunities for career growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding company
  • Remote work with flexible hours, allowing for healthy work-life balance
  • Goal-oriented work culture providing autonomy and opportunities for personal and professional development

How to Apply

If you're an experienced finance leader with a passion for driving business growth and a love for coffee, we want to hear from you! To apply at Pro Coffee Gear, please submit your resume along with a cover letter highlighting your relevant controller experience and achievements. Join us in shaping the future of coffee and contributing to our company's continued growth and success.

Please note: All applicants must submit their CV in English. CVs in other languages will automatically be disqualified.

At Pro Coffee Gear, we believe in the strength of diversity and equal opportunities for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Davis Wright Tremaine LLP is looking for a Conflicts Analystto join our team in our Seattle, Portland, San Francisco, Los Angeles, New Yorkor Washington D.C.offices.

This is a temporary position lasting six months. This position offers the flexibility to be fully remote while working within reasonable commuting distance from any of our offices.

This position is responsible for performing a variety of tasks including searching and validation of records, flagging potential issues, conducting corporate research, and validation of conflicts reports for accuracy with regard to new client business, incoming lateral attorneys, and other professional staff.

At Davis Wright Tremaine, you will find challenging assignments, opportunities for professional growth and community involvement, and a culture of inclusion. DWT fosters inclusiveness and authenticity. Regardless of position, everyone here has a voice and the support is unparalleled.

On a typical day you will:

  • Perform conflict of interest searches on incoming lateral attorneys in a timely manner. Provide detailed analysis of potential conflicts of interest to Conflicts Attorneys as appropriate
  • Communicate with firm attorneys to determine whether clients remain current clients of the firm and, if applicable, update the records to reflect former client status. Review client/matter name changes for potential conflicts of interest

Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: SCADA Engineer Intern – I – Critical Infrastructure

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States, Atlanta, GA, or Dallas, TX

Summer 2027 Internship Dates: May 17th, 2027- August 13th, 2027

JOB SUMMARY

The SCADA Engineering Intern supports the development, testing, and documentation of SCADA systems for mission-critical (Data Center) infrastructure projects.

This is a hands-on learning opportunity for students or recent graduates interested in software development, industrial automation, controls, and AI-enabled engineering. The intern will work under the guidance of experienced engineers and contribute to clearly defined project assignments.

Previous professional SCADA experience is not required. Candidates should demonstrate technical curiosity, attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and an interest in industrial automation.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

SCADA Development & Support

  • Assist with developing SCADA graphics, tags, alarms, scripts, templates, and reusable components
  • Support basic PLC and SCADA integration activities
  • Help translate documented requirements and sequences of operation into functional SCADA configurations
  • Follow established development standards, naming conventions, and engineering processes
  • Make corrections and improvements based on engineering review and feedback

Testing & Documentation

  • Execute assigned test procedures and document the results
  • Support quality reviews, defect tracking, and basic troubleshooting
  • Verify completed work against documented requirements
  • Assist with technical documentation, test records, tag lists, alarm lists, and engineering notes
  • Clearly communicate identified issues, questions, and completed work

Development Tools & AI

  • Use Git for source control, including branches, commits, and pull requests
  • Use Docker and VM environments to create and develop projects
  • Use Azure DevOps to manage work items, repositories, testing, and documentation
  • Use approved generative AI and agentic AI tools for coding, testing, research, documentation, and workflow improvement
  • Review and validate AI-generated work before using it

Training & Technical Growth

  • Participate in Ignition 8.3 SCADA platform training with the potential opportunity to earn an certification
  • Gain practical exposure to Rockwell Automation PLCs and other industrial control systems
  • Learn SCADA architecture, HMI design, alarming, scripting, data modeling, industrial networking, and communications
  • Participate in technical discussions, demonstrations, and supervised project activities
  • Apply feedback and demonstrate continuous improvement

Project Support

  • Complete assigned tasks on time and within the defined scope
  • Communicate progress, questions, and technical issues to the assigned engineer
  • Participate in supervised testing, commissioning, or field activities when available
  • Follow established engineering, cybersecurity, safety, and quality requirements
  • Perform other related duties as assigned

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

  • Basic understanding of programming, networking, databases, controls, or automation
  • Familiarity with Git or another source-control tool
  • Foundational understanding of generative AI or agentic AI concepts
  • Interest in SCADA systems, PLCs, industrial automation, and mission-critical infrastructure
  • Ability to follow technical instructions and documented processes
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
  • Ability to communicate questions, progress, and technical issues clearly
  • Ability to work effectively with engineering and project teams
  • Ability to protect confidential company and customer information

PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)

oExposure to Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, C#, or a similar programming language

oExperience with Git, GitHub, Azure Repos, or Azure DevOps

oFamiliarity with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, or container orchestration

oFamiliarity with APIs, JSON, databases, or AI-assisted development

oExposure to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA platforms, or industrial communication protocols

oFamiliarity with Ignition, Rockwell Automation, Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, REST API or MQTT

oCoursework, personal projects, laboratory work, or previous technical internship experience

INTERN DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES

  • Ignition 8.3 SCADA development and platform administration
  • Potential Ignition Core certification opportunities
  • Rockwell Automation PLCs and other industrial control technologies
  • SCADA graphics, alarming, scripting, data modeling, testing, and system integration
  • Git, Azure DevOps, source control, work-item tracking, and code reviews
  • Docker, containerized applications, Kubernetes, and orchestration fundamentals
  • Generative AI, agentic AI, and AI-assisted engineering workflows
  • Mission-critical infrastructure projects
  • Mentorship from experienced SCADA, software, controls, and system integration professionals

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of

this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential

functions.

  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working on a computer
  • Ability to move through offices, job sites, control rooms, and equipment spaces as needed
  • Ability to occasionally lift or move tools or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • This is primarily a remote or office-based position
  • Limited supervised travel may be available for training, testing, commissioning, or project-site exposure
  • Travel will depend on project requirements, internship timing, and intern availability

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree, certification, apprenticeship, or technical program in:

oComputer Science

oSoftware Engineering

oElectrical or Computer Engineering

oControls or Automation

oInformation Technology

oIndustrial Technology

oArtificial Intelligence

oA related technical discipline

The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

Job Title:

Senior Solution Architect-Customer Experience - CX Solutioning

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

The Senior Solution Architect is responsible for designing automation solutions that help clients transform customer experiences, improve operational efficiency, and unlock measurable business value. This role serves as a trusted consultant, leading discovery and due diligence sessions to understand end-user needs, identify automation opportunities, build business cases, support proposals, and contribute to contract-ready solution content.

In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Finance, Legal, and client stakeholders to shape compelling, practical, and differentiated solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Determine the most appropriate automation solution in partnership with the Sales Representative and Sales Engineer through client discovery discussions, RFP/RFI reviews, and other solution requests.
  • Collaborate with Professional Services leaders and team members to design robust, scalable, and client-ready solutions.
  • Develop the solution approach, including estimated timelines, ROI models, presentation materials, and supporting documentation.
  • Identify, manage, and resolve issues that may impact solution quality, delivery timelines, resources, or client expectations.
  • Partner with Sales and Finance teams to evaluate pricing strategies, determine recommended approaches, and support approval processes.
  • Understand and escalate potential risks across solution components, working with the Solutions Director to identify risk mitigation alternatives.
  • Contribute content for scope of work documents, proposals, and contract-related materials.
  • Facilitate meetings to review pricing, staffing, timelines, contracts, and presentation materials requiring stakeholder alignment.
  • Attend client site visits in various locations with the Sales Representative and other key team members, as needed.
  • Conduct research on current and prospective clients, verticals, and industries to provide subject matter expertise and identify opportunities to differentiate the Concentrix solution.
  • Support Sales Representatives in gathering appropriate resources to follow Concentrix processes and protections, including Non-Disclosure Agreements, Deal Review, Legal, Security Risk/Controls, and related requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the opportunity management process to help the team work more efficiently and deliver effective messaging.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or 8+ years of related experience in one or more of the following areas: consulting, user-centered design, voice/digital bots/channels, customer experience, industry verticals, contact center operations, cloud services, sales support, or marketing.
  • Experience with bots, self-service applications, and communication channels such as Voice/IVR and Messaging/Chat/Omni.
  • Knowledge of user experience design and customer experience best practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio.
  • Proven ability to organize and prioritize projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven business environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to take initiative, show ownership, and focus on continuous improvement.
  • Strong customer service mindset, professional presence, and consultative approach.
  • Solid understanding of business operations and industry dynamics, with demonstrated business acumen.
  • Demonstrated ability to comprehend, analyze, and interpret information to support solution development and decision-making.

The base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000 a year, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays.

The deadline to apply for this position is 10/26/2026.

raw.excerpt: Position Summary: The Senior Consultant leads complex analytical and delivery work across Federal transformation engagements.
raw.description:
Position Summary:

The Senior Consultant leads complex analytical and delivery work across Federal transformation engagements. This person frames problems, designs the work approach, facilitates stakeholders, integrates evidence, develops recommendations, and owns client-ready deliverables. Senior Consultants bring depth in one or more capability areas while remaining adaptable across requirements, acquisition, data, process, governance, change, performance, and delivery assignments.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Consultant: $120,000 – $140,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Own complex work packages or major deliverable components from planning through client acceptance.
  • Translate ambiguous client questions into structured analyses, workplans, evidence needs, and decision points.
  • Plan and lead interviews, workshops, validation sessions, process reviews, and working meetings.
  • Analyze competing evidence, identify gaps and tradeoffs, and develop defensible findings and recommendations.
  • Create or tailor methods, templates, taxonomies, analytical criteria, quality checks, and performance measures.
  • Coordinate dependencies across mission, acquisition, financial, technology, data, and organizational stakeholders.
  • Draft and brief client-ready reports, roadmaps, dashboards, governance products, implementation plans, or executive decision materials.
  • Review and improve team work products; coach Consultants in analysis, writing, facilitation, and consulting judgment.
  • Manage risks, assumptions, decisions, and scope within the assigned work; escalate material issues promptly.
  • Develop capability across adjacent disciplines so the practice can redeploy talent as mission needs change.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience; advanced degree or relevant certification welcomed.
  • Typically 6–10 years of progressively responsible consulting, Federal delivery, analysis, transformation, acquisition, data, process, change, or program experience.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex deliverables, stakeholder sessions, analyses, and recommendations.
  • Strong facilitation, analytical writing, executive communication, problem structuring, and quality-review skills.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, balance multiple priorities, and make sound recommendations using incomplete information.
  • Experience coaching or coordinating junior team members and collaborating across functional disciplines.
  • Five non-negotiable consulting competencies
  • Ownership and Bias for Action: Anticipates what the workstream needs and resolves obstacles.
  • Learning Agility and Curiosity: Transfers expertise across domains and improves the method as evidence develops.
  • Team-First Collaboration: Coaches others, shares context, and integrates perspectives without ego.
  • Resilience and Positive Energy: Keeps teams focused and constructive through ambiguity and client pressure.
  • Trustworthiness and Commitment: Surfaces risks early and delivers what was promised.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Requirements development and management, business analysis, traceability, capability analysis, or systems analysis.
  • Data inventory, normalization, quality, analysis, visualization, dashboard design, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, SQL, or related tools.
  • Organizational change, stakeholder engagement, communications, facilitation, training, roadshows, or adoption measurement.
  • Program or project management, integrated scheduling, risk and dependency management, quality assurance, PWS development, or executive reporting.
  • DHS, CISA, cybersecurity, or another complex Federal mission environment; ability to obtain and maintain required suitability and access.
  • Federal acquisition, contracting, procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or contract-portfolio analysis.
  • Experience leading complex change for Federal programs
  • Enterprise process improvement, operating-model design, governance, decision rights, performance measurement, or Lean Six Sigma.
  • Experience with process optimization a big plus.

Work Environment:

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Cherokee Nation Solutions Link, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

For applicants located in Colorado, New York, California, Washington, Illinois, Hawaii, Massachusetts, or other states with pay transparency requirements: the estimated annual salary range for this position is $120,000 – $140,000. Actual compensation varies based on qualifications, experience, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Cherokee Federal is a federal contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA). As required by VEVRAA, we take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans. Protected veterans are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Cherokee Federal takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Qualified individuals with disabilities are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact Human Resources at .

raw.description:
Position Type: Full-Time | Remote
Employment Type: 1099 Contractor
Working Hours: Flexible 40 hours between 7:30 AM and 7:30 PM CST

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive and personable Client Success Specialist to support professional clients, primarily attorneys, through a podcasting and content production service.

You’ll be responsible for making sure clients have a smooth experience from onboarding through ongoing podcast production. This includes guiding clients through processes, resolving issues, coordinating recordings, keeping clients on track and serving as their primary point of contact throughout the engagement.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, confident communicating with clients, comfortable following up assertively, and able to manage multiple client needs while maintaining a professional and friendly experience.

Key Responsibilities

Client Onboarding & Support

  • Onboard new clients and guide them through the required processes and workflows.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients.
  • Answer client questions and address concerns in a timely and professional manner.
  • Resolve issues related to payments, content selection, marketing copy, reports, and other client needs.
  • Ensure clients understand next steps and remain informed throughout the process.

Podcast Scheduling & Production Coordination

  • Schedule podcast recordings with clients.
  • Manage and track production timelines.
  • Follow up with clients to ensure recordings and required materials are completed on schedule.
  • Keep client information and production status organized and up to date.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to keep projects moving smoothly.

Client Success & Retention

  • Regularly check in with clients to ensure they are progressing through the podcasting pipeline.
  • Monitor client satisfaction and proactively identify potential issues.
  • Help clients stay engaged and on track with their podcast production.
  • Support additional client success needs that reasonably fall within the scope of the engagement.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in customer service, client success, account management or a similar client-facing role.
  • Experience working with professional clients, particularly attorneys or other high-value professional services clients, is preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Confident, personable, and assertive communication style.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Ability to learn and follow established processes and workflows.
  • Reliable computer with at least 8GB RAM.
  • High-speed, reliable internet with a wired connection preferred.
  • Good-quality external webcam suitable for regular client video calls.
  • Professional, dedicated workspace with a clean and appropriate background.
  • Good-quality headset or microphone.
  • Willingness to use workflow monitoring software as part of the remote work environment.
  • Ability to complete additional assessments or tests when required.

Nice to Have

  • Marketing or social media experience.
  • Podcasting, broadcasting, media, or content production experience.
  • Experience working with attorneys, law firms, or other professional service providers.

Typical Day

You may start the day reviewing client progress and identifying upcoming recordings, outstanding materials, or follow-ups. You’ll communicate with clients throughout the day, schedule podcast recordings, resolve questions or issues, and coordinate with internal teams to keep production timelines on track.

You’ll also regularly check in with clients, update their progress and make sure they understand what is needed from them at each stage of the process.

Interview Process

  1. AI Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer Stage

With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We're in a major growth phase at Bluelight, and we're seeking a highly driven Business Development Representative (BDR) with strong outbound sales experience to expand our client base. This role is focused on high-volume outbound prospecting, cold outreach, and booking qualified appointments. The ideal candidate is confident speaking with U.S.-based decision-makers, has excellent English communication skills, and thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven sales environment.

What You'll Do

  • Initiate outbound conversations with confidence, clearly communicating Bluelight's value proposition within the first few seconds
  • Qualify prospects based on defined criteria (budget, authority, need, timeline) and identify real sales opportunities
  • Handle objections effectively and position Bluelight as a solution to prospects' software and technology needs
  • Book qualified discovery calls for Account Executives and ensure strong show rates through proper follow-up
  • Accurately log all activities, notes, and pipeline updates in HubSpot
  • Continuously improve messaging and outreach strategies based on results
  • Meet or exceed KPIs including daily activity targets, conversations, meetings booked, and pipeline contribution

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in B2B sales or inside sales roles, preferably within technology or software industries
  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers confidently
  • Familiarity with CRM software such as Salesforce or similar platforms
  • Experience in telemarketing or outbound calling campaigns is highly desirable
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with a customer service-oriented approach
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment

Nice to Have

  • Apollo - for prospecting and lead discovery
  • Clay - for building enriched, targeted outreach lists
  • Instantly - for outbound email sequences and cadences
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and improve outreach performance

What Success Looks Like

  • Hitting daily activity and meeting targets
  • Generating high-quality, qualified meetings
  • Building a consistent and predictable pipeline
  • Clearly communicating Bluelight's value

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply.

raw.title: Senior Product Owner (m/w/d) – Personal.manager / Klinik / Dienstplanung
raw.excerpt: deine rolleDer Personal. manager ist unsere cloudbasierte Lösung für Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatzplanung und Zeitwirtschaft im Krankenhaus.
raw.description:
deine rolle

Der Personal.manager ist unsere cloudbasierte Lösung für Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatzplanung und Zeitwirtschaft im Krankenhaus. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Person, die die Produktverantwortung übernimmt und Projekte rund um das Produkt plant und steuert.

Du hast Lust auf Themen, wie Dienstplanung, Abwesenheiten, Regelwerke und Schichtbetrieb, und kannst das in saubere Produktarbeit übersetzen: Backlog pflegen, User Stories schreiben, mit dem Team im Scrum-Prozess arbeiten, Stakeholder steuern und Roadmap-Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Mission
Du führst den `Personal.manager` produktseitig so, dass wir in einer komplexen Krankenhausrealität klar priorisieren, sauber entscheiden und verlässlich liefern können.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen zusammen, die das Produkt und die Domäne seit Jahren kennen, aber die PO-Rolle zeitlich nicht in der nötigen Tiefe ausfüllen können. Die fachliche Erfahrung und das Produktwissen sind also vorhanden. Was fehlt, ist eine dedizierte Person, die Produktverantwortung in Vollzeit übernimmt, Entscheidungen vorbereitet, den Backlog führt und die Delivery im Alltag steuert.

Kurz gesagt:

Du machst aus Komplexität ein steuerbares Produkt.

Worum es in der Rolle wirklich geht
Der "Personal.manager" bildet produktive Prozesse in Kliniken ab: Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatz, Abwesenheiten, Arbeitszeit- und Tariflogik, Qualifikationssteuerung und Integrationen in gewachsene Systemlandschaften. Das ist fachlich komplex, regulatorisch anspruchsvoll und für die Kunden operativ kritisch.

Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der diese Domäne versteht und gleichzeitig das Handwerk mitbringt: User Stories formulieren, Akzeptanzkriterien ausarbeiten, das Backlog sauber halten, Refinements vorbereiten und moderieren, im Sprint-Alltag mit dem Team arbeiten und nach Gesprächen mit der Entwicklung wissen, worum es geht, richtige Fragen stellen und Entscheidungen treffen, hinter denen man steht. Seniorität heißt hier nicht „nur noch strategisch denken", sondern die fachliche Tiefe mitbringen, die es braucht, damit die operative Produktarbeit stimmt.

das wirst du tun

Produkt & Roadmap

  • Du verantwortest Roadmap und Priorisierung, triffst klare Produktentscheidungen und machst Zielkonflikte transparent.
  • Du schreibst User Stories mit testbaren Akzeptanzkriterien, pflegst den Backlog und klärst offene Fragen früh mit Fachseite und Entwicklung.
  • Du übersetzt Feedback aus Nutzung, Support und Betrieb in priorisierte Verbesserungen.

Projekte

  • Du planst und steuerst Projekte wie Kundeneinführungen, Migrationen, Integrationen oder interne Initiativen.
  • Du verantwortest Meilensteine, Ressourcen und Abhängigkeiten und behältst dabei Zeit, Budget und Qualität im Blick.
  • Du erkennst Risiken früh, eskalierst rechtzeitig und berichtest transparent, auch in Lenkungskreisen.

Delivery – agil und klassisch

  • Du arbeitest aktiv in den Scrum-Formaten mit und moderierst Refinements, aus denen lieferfähige Arbeit entsteht.
  • In Kunden- und Einführungsprojekten steuerst du klassisch oder hybrid, je nachdem, was zum Projekt passt.
  • Du begleitest Releases und koordinierst die Kommunikation zu geplanten Änderungen.

Stakeholder

  • Du bündelst Anforderungen aus Management, Support, Operations und Kundenprojekten sowie von externen Partnern.
  • Du bereitest Themen entscheidungsreif auf und kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt „nein“ oder „nicht jetzt“ sagen.

Warum die Rolle spannend ist

Du arbeitest an einem Produkt, das in einem hochrelevanten und operativ anspruchsvollen Umfeld eingesetzt wird. Gute Produktarbeit hat hier direkten Einfluss auf Planbarkeit, Fairness, Alltagstauglichkeit und Umsetzbarkeit in Kliniken.

Du bekommst in dieser Rolle echten Gestaltungsspielraum. Du kannst mitprägen, wie professionell, klar und wirksam Produktarbeit im "Personal.manager" funktioniert.

das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager, Projektmanager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit echter Verantwortung
  • Erfahrung mit Software im Krankenhaus oder in einem nahen, regulierten klinischen Umfeld
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Dienstplanung, Personaleinsatzplanung, Zeitwirtschaft oder Schichtbetrieb
  • Praxis in agilem und klassischem Projektmanagement; User Stories schreibst du auch selbst
  • Die Fähigkeit, unklare Anforderungen in klare, testbare und umsetzbare Arbeit zu übersetzen
  • Souveränität im Umgang mit Stakeholdern auf Fach-, Projekt- und Management-Ebene
  • Technisches Verständnis, um mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Sehr starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Deutsch auf C2-Niveau


Das wäre besonders hilfreich
  • Erfahrung mit B2B-SaaS im Gesundheitswesen
  • Erfahrung in größeren Einführungs- oder Transformationskontexten
  • Verständnis für Integrationslandschaften, z. B. im SAP- oder HR-nahen Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit Produktmetriken, Support-Signalen und datenbasierter Priorisierung

das bieten wir dir

  • Du arbeitest in einer Unternehmensgruppe mit kurzen Wegen & echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Du findest bei uns keine starre Konzernlogik, sondern die Möglichkeit, Dinge wirksam zu gestalten und sichtbar voranzubringen.
  • Und du arbeitest an Lösungen, die einen echten Unterschied machen – für Unternehmen, für Prozesse und am Ende für Menschen.
  • Maximale Flexibilität beim Arbeitsort: 100 % Remote, Hybrid oder 100 % vor Ort in St. Wendel – so, wie es zu Deinem Leben passt
  • Regelmäßige Schulungen und Weiterbildungen, damit Du fachlich und technologisch am Ball bleibst
  • Ein kollegiales, pragmatisches Team mit echtem Gestaltungswillen und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein faires Gehalt, das Deiner Erfahrung, Verantwortung und Rolle entspricht
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • Für nicht remote arbeitende Menschen: Modernes Büro mit Dusche, Waschmaschine und einer hochwertigen Siebträgermaschine

unsere ansprüche und ziele

  • Roadmap und Priorisierung sind für alle relevanten Stakeholder nachvollziehbar und belastbar.
  • Anforderungen gehen klar vorbereitet in die Umsetzung, und Refinements führen zu Entscheidungen statt zu neuer Unschärfe.
  • Projekte laufen planbar: Meilensteine werden gehalten, Risiken werden früh sichtbar und Abweichungen rechtzeitig eskaliert.
  • Kunden und interne Beteiligte wissen jederzeit, wo ein Projekt steht.
  • Releases und Änderungen werden transparent und verlässlich kommuniziert.
  • Produkt- und Projektentscheidungen orientieren sich an der Klinik- und Nutzerrealität, nicht an der Lautstärke einzelner Anforderungen.

bewerbung

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf und gern ein paar kurzen Hinweisen auf Produkte, Kontexte oder Verantwortungsbereiche, in denen du bereits Produktverantwortung in komplexen, erklärungsbedürftigen oder regulierten Umfeldern übernommen hast.

raw.title: Senior Account Executive
raw.excerpt: About ConexEDConexED is a rapidly growing higher education technology company transforming how institutions enroll, support, engage, and retain students.
raw.description:
About ConexED

ConexED is a rapidly growing higher education technology company transforming how institutions enroll, support, engage, and retain students. Our platform powers advising, student services, and institutional workflows at colleges and universities nationwide.

We are entering a major growth phase, coming off two recent statewide RFP wins, expanding our institutional footprint, and investing heavily in building the next category-defining company in higher education.

ConexED is led by a CEO who is a former CRO and proven growth leader, having helped take three companies to the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Privately Held Companies list, with ConexED positioned to be the fourth. This is an opportunity to join a leadership team with a demonstrated track record of building, scaling, and winning.

Role Overview

The Senior Account Executive will own new business development across an assigned territory or vertical, driving net-new ARR from community colleges, technical colleges, and universities. This is a full-cycle, high-ownership role for a seller who thrives in consultative, multi-stakeholder deals and is energized by complex buying environments.

You will manage the full sales cycle from prospecting through close, working closely with Customer Success, Marketing, and executive leadership to position ConexED as the clear choice for institutions ready to modernize student services. You will carry a quota, own your pipeline, and be expected to bring the strategic thinking and competitive instincts that winning enterprise deals requires.

We expect this person to be AI-native. ConexED treats AI as core leverage, not a side experiment, and the Senior AE will use tools like Claude across research, outreach, proposal development, and deal strategy to operate with the output of a much larger team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a defined territory or vertical and hit quarterly and annual net-new ARR quota
  • Manage the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of 3–4x quota coverage through outbound activity, inbound follow-up, and strategic account targeting
  • Lead multi-stakeholder discovery to understand institutional pain points, student success goals, and technical requirements across Student Affairs, IT, and executive buyers
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and customized proposals that map ConexED’s platform to each institution’s strategic priorities
  • Navigate complex procurement processes including RFPs, state system evaluations, and multi-year contract negotiations
  • Partner with Marketing on ABM campaigns, conference presence, and outbound sequencing to build awareness and generate pipeline in your territory
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs and support expansion opportunities within your book of new logos
  • Maintain accurate pipeline, activity, and forecast data in HubSpot as the system of record
  • Use AI tools like Claude to accelerate research, prospecting, proposal writing, and deal strategy, and build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that make you more effective
  • Represent ConexED at regional and national higher education conferences to build relationships and generate pipeline

Required Qualifications

  • 3–7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with sales cycles of 3–6+ months
  • Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to lead discovery, map pain to value, and build business cases for executive buyers
  • Proven ability to build pipeline through outbound prospecting, not just inbound or SDR-sourced leads
  • Experience with CRM platforms—HubSpot strongly preferred—and disciplined pipeline and forecast hygiene
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, written and verbal, across all levels of a buying organization
  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools such as Claude, and a demonstrated habit of using them to research, write, and strategize faster

Preferred / Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience selling into higher education, K–12, or the public sector
  • Familiarity with community college or technical college buying processes, funding models, and RFP-driven procurement
  • Background selling student success, advising, enrollment, or institutional software platforms
  • Experience navigating statewide or consortium-level procurement processes
  • Track record of winning competitive displacements against established vendors

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meets or exceeds quarterly and annual net-new ARR quota
  • Builds and maintains a healthy, diverse pipeline with strong coverage and accurate forecasting
  • Runs tight, disciplined discovery and moves deals forward with urgency and clear next steps
  • Wins competitive deals against legacy players by articulating ConexED’s differentiated value
  • Builds lasting relationships with institutional champions and economic buyers that generate referrals and expansion
  • Operates as a self-sufficient, AI-augmented seller who produces more output and insight per hour than a traditional rep

Why Join ConexED

  • Join a company at a pivotal growth moment, coming off major statewide wins and expanding nationally
  • Carry a real quota with real upside—competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity participation
  • Sell a platform with genuine mission impact: helping colleges retain and support more students
  • Work directly with a CEO and CRO who are operators, not bureaucrats, and who actively support deals
  • Be part of a sales team that wins with intelligence and strategy, not just volume and hustle
  • Competitive compensation with meaningful upside

Senior Principal Engineer, Solutions Architecture - Networking

Dell Services is growing, and we are seeking seasoned network professionals with expertise in AI infrastructure planning, high-performance networking, data center fabrics, and enterprise network transformation. Dell provides a complete end-to-end suite of products, services, and support for modern IT environments, including AI factories, accelerated computing platforms, HPC environments, data center networks, campus networks, and cloud-integrated architectures.

The Global Professional Services Network team provides assessment, architecture, design, implementation, and consulting services for Dell's networking and AI infrastructure solutions. This Network Planning Engineer will develop and maintain deep expertise in AI-ready network architectures, including high-speed Ethernet fabrics, GPU interconnect technologies, data center networking, campus networking, security, and network automation.

What you’ll achieve:

The primary purpose of this role is to work directly with customers to assess, design, plan, migrate, integrate, and optimize networking infrastructures that support AI workloads, accelerated computing platforms, and modern enterprise environments. The engineer will act as a trusted technical advisor for customers building or expanding AI capabilities, ensuring that networking architectures deliver the performance, scalability, resiliency, and operational simplicity required for next-generation AI and data-intensive workloads.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a Senior Principal Engineer, Solutions Architecture - Networking on our Solutions Architecture team.

raw.description:
Prazer, somos a ITIX!

Uma fábrica de software com sólida experiência em transformar negócios de ponta a ponta. Com um time de especialistas em diversos setores, construímos um produto adequado às necessidades do negócio do cliente, com a cabeça no futuro, e os pés no presente.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia preocupada com a diversidade do nosso time - Diferentes pessoas trazem diferentes pensamentos e esse é nosso objetivo por aqui.

Se você é uma pessoa proativa, apaixonada por tecnologia, possui familiaridade com metodologia ágil, gosta de solucionar problemas, buscar melhorias contínuas e bons resultados, se você chegou aqui... temos algo em comum.

Revolucionamos o mercado tradicional de tecnologia, crescemos, evoluímos, e se você deseja fazer parte disso, continue por aqui.

Bora fazer parte do nosso #DreamTeamItix?

O Analista de Processos será responsável por:

Mapear, redesenhar e sustentar os processos que suportam os produtos e operações da empresa, conduzindo jornadas AS IS → TO BE de ponta a ponta e transformando diagnósticos em ganhos mensuráveis de eficiência, custo, qualidade e aderência regulatória. Atua junto aos squads de Produtos.

Principais responsabilidades:

- Levantar e documentar processos AS IS com as áreas operacionais, comerciais e jurídicas, identificando gargalos, retrabalho, riscos e pontos de controle;

- Desenhar o TO BE com ganhos quantificados, validar a solução com as áreas e dar devolutiva estruturada;

- Apoiar os profissionais de Produtos na tradução de processos em épicos, histórias e critérios de aceite, para que a solução cubra a jornada completa e não apenas o sistema;

- Garantir que os processos redesenhados atendam aos requisitos regulatórios do negócio (BACEN, ANTT), em conjunto com Jurídico e Compliance;

- Definir e acompanhar indicadores de processo (prazo, custo, qualidade, produtividade) e OKRs táticos ligados às melhorias;

- Identificar oportunidades de automação e de uso de IA aplicada, priorizando por impacto e esforço;

- Conduzir a implantação: plano de mudança, treinamento, procedimentos e acompanhamento da adoção;

- Manter backlog de melhorias priorizado, gestão à vista e status report executivo recorrente.


São requisitosobrigatórios:

- Experiência sólida em mapeamento e redesenho de processos (BPMN, SIPOC, mapeamento de fluxo de valor) em empresas de grande porte e alta complexidade;

- Projetos de melhoria contínua conduzidos de ponta a ponta com resultado mensurado (Lean, Six Sigma, PDCA, Kaizen);

- Atuação direta com áreas de negócio em diferentes níveis de maturidade digital, incluindo liderança executiva;

- Leitura de dados e de relatórios gerenciais (DRE, receita, custo, faturamento) para sustentar casos de melhoria e redução de custo;

- Vivência em ambiente ágil, trabalhando com squads, backlog e sprints;

- Experiência com OKRs e indicadores de desempenho;

- Uso prático de IA no dia a dia de trabalho.

  • Ferramentas:

Modelagem de processos em BPMN 2.0: Bizagi, Lucidchart, Visio ou equivalentes;

Gestão de backlog e demandas: Jira, Azure DevOps ou equivalentes;

Documentação e colaboração: Confluence, SharePoint, Miro;

Análise e indicadores: Excel avançado e Power BI.

São requisitosdesejáveis/diferenciais:

- Certificação CBPP(ABPMP) ou Lean Six Sigma Green Belt ou Black Belt;

- Experiência em negócios regulados e relacionamento com órgãos como BACEN e ANTT;

- Vivência em transporte, logística, mobilidade, meios de pagamento ou serviços financeiros;

- Conhecimento do ecossistema: torre de controle, tracking, seguros, débitos veiculares, vale-pedágio, CIOT, antecipação de recebíveis e de frete, cartões, conta digital;

- Process mining e automação de processos (RPA, Power Automate, workflows);

- Design Thinking e facilitação de workshops;

- Certificação ágil (CSPO, PSPO ou Kanban).

Informações adicionais

Alguns diferenciais que fazem sucesso por aqui:

💨 Cultura dinâmica: Novas tecnologias surgem constantemente e exigem das empresas velocidade e agilidade para se manterem competitivas. E a ITIX está no mercado para permitir que seus clientes evoluam por meio da tecnologia.

🌿Anywhere Office:Liberdadegeográfica para trabalhar do local que fizer sentido para você*;

🛍️ Parceiros de desconto: Vários cupons e indicações de parcerias você aproveitar: aluguel de carro, escolas de idioma, cursos de graduação e pós, etc.;

👯‍♀️Programa de indicação: Se você conhece alguém que possa fazer parte da nossa missão de tornar o mundo mais saudável, temos um Programa de Indicação de Talentos com direito a uma premiação bem interessante;

🎂 Day off: Aniversário;

🏋🏻‍♀️ Totalpass/Wellhub: Escolha o que faz sentido para a sua rotina saudável;

🩺 Plataforma de Telemedicina: Ecossistema digital para cuidado integrado da saúde física e mental;

🧘‍♀️Programa de ações de saúde e qualidade de vida: pensando sempre no bem estar do colaborador, realizamos diversas ações voltadas para o bem-estar;

🎱Momentos de descontração: Em nossas unidades, você vai encontrar um ambiente super legal, com puff, sinuca, videogame, sala de descanso, cozinha equipada, claro que não poderia faltar, open do combustível diário ☕ o nosso cafezinho.

Major Responsibilities

  • Maintain as well as develop positive customer relationships and create value through consultative sales practices
  • Establish plans for the retention and subsequent growth, of assigned customers in the sales territory
  • Communicate effectively with office team to ensure outstanding customer support.
  • Develop technical expertise and knowledge of strategic products and product lines.
  • Provide market information and feedback as required.
  • Ensure proper merchandising implementation at customers by actively participating in the merchandising process in cooperation with Team Leader, Customers and Marketing department.
  • Control the activities of distributors such as level of orders for stores, the availability of goods offered and the level of services.
  • Prepare and submit commercial offers and support the active promotion of the products e.g. product presentations, product trainings, etc.
  • Implement established sales plans and other tasks related to customers.
  • Actively cooperate and coordinate activities linked to distributors’ representatives.
  • Resilience when facing rejection (this is sales after all… you will be rejected often)

We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too.

Joining the Stanley Black & Decker team means working in an innovative, tech-driven and highly collaborative team environment supported by over 43,500 professionals in 60 countries across the globe. Here, you’ll get the unique chance to impact some of the world’s most iconic brands including STANLEY TOOLS, DEWALT, CRAFTSMAN, MAC TOOLS and Black + Decker. Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights.

Who We Are

We’re the World’s largest tool company. We’re industry visionaries. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company.

Global Benefits & Perks
You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire.

What You’ll Also Get

Career Opportunity: Career paths aren’t linear here. Being part of our global company with 60+ brands gives you the chance to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths.

Learning & Development:
Our lifelong learning philosophy means you’ll have access to a wealth of state-of-the-art learning resources, including our Lean Academy and online university (where you can get certificates and specializations from renowned colleges and universities).

Diverse & Inclusive Culture:
We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too.

Purpose-Driven Company:
You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

raw.description:
Our mission is to Profoundly change the standard of care by creating a tomorrow where clinicians can confidently ablate tissue with precision; a tomorrow where patients have access to safe and effective treatment options, so they can quickly return to their daily lives. Changing the standard of care is part of our fabric. We are a group of energetic, problem-solvers focused on innovation, and looking to change the world. We are changing the paradigm for treating diseases such as prostate cancer by using real-time MR Imaging, thermal ultrasound and close-loop temperature feedback control, to gently ablate the diseased tissue with minimal side effects.

If you share our values and want to work in a collaborative results focused culture and want to make a Profound impact in healthcare and your career, here is your chance.

General Accountability:

The Capital Sales Executive is responsible for selling TULSA-Pro to both new and existing hospital and imaging center accounts within the assigned territory. This role requires deep expertise in the imaging and urology markets, along with a strong understanding of the hospital and imaging center capital procurement process.

Key responsibilities include building a team of champions among administrators, physicians, and support staff, utilizing advanced solution-selling skills, and demonstrating persistence and resilience to consistently meet sales objectives. The Capital Sales Executive is expected to deliver high-quality information and presentations to physicians, administrators, and purchasing teams, guiding them through the capital equipment approval and purchasing process.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Generate market awareness and drive sales of TULSA-Pro within an assigned sales territory.
  • Generate a high volume of sales activity including in-person prospecting, product evaluations, phone calls, proposal / contract generation, customer presentations, and negotiations.
  • Ensure that pipeline supports achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual goals.
  • Manage the complex sales process into new hospitals, HW, SW and service upgrades and additional systems into existing hospitals
  • Build clinical and administrative support through presentations, executive meetings, marketing events, and reimbursement support.
  • Effectively manage transition of initial sale and installation to the account management team to drive procedural volume and growth.
  • Achieve quarterly sales targets with a goal of closing 3 new programs with a purchase of packs with a strategic plan within a year.
  • Partner with the Director of Sales to develop a sales plan for their assigned territory to meet and exceed goals.
  • Initiate contact with C suite and senior hospital administrators.
  • Drive market awareness and increase sales of TULSA-Pro within the assigned territory.
  • Generate a high volume of sales activity, including in-person prospecting, product evaluations, phone calls, proposal and contract generation, customer presentations, and negotiations.
  • Maintain a robust pipeline to support monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
  • Manage the complex sales process for new hospital accounts, including hardware, software, service upgrades, and additional systems for existing hospital customers.
  • Build clinical and administrative support through presentations, executive meetings, marketing events, and reimbursement support.
  • Oversee the transition from the initial sale and installation to the account management team to drive procedural volume and ongoing growth.
  • Meet quarterly sales targets with the goal of securing 3 new program installations and pack purchases within the year, following a strategic plan.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales to develop a targeted sales plan for the territory to meet and exceed objectives.
  • Establish contact with C-suite and senior hospital administrators to build strategic partnerships.
  • Manage relationships with key customer stakeholders, including Clinical Nursing, C-suite Executives, Hospital Administrators, Urologists, Radiologists, and Interventional Radiologists.
  • Build a compelling business case for system approval and purchase by developing relationships with stakeholders and delivering a strong value proposition.
  • Lead contract creation, negotiation, and management activities, overcoming any challenges with administration and purchasing teams.
  • Oversee revenue recognition activities while ensuring a successful system installation and program launch.
  • Stay current with hospital credentialing requirements, including routine background checks, inoculations, and necessary training.

Education and Certification:

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

Key Attributes (experience, skills and technical knowledge):

  • Minimum of 2-3 years of sales experience in the medical device industry.
  • Strong understanding of the capital procurement process within hospitals or imaging centers.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated success in capital medical equipment sales, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets.
  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently; skilled in critical thinking and problem-solving in high-pressure situations.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 80%, depending on account distribution.
