What success looks like in this role:

Curiosity, creativity, and a relentless drive to improve are at the heart of this role. As a Digital Intelligence Analyst, you'll help manage and administer the Marketing Insight technology stack for Unisys, working directly with our Marketing Digital intelligence Senior Manager. It's a hands-on role with real room to grow: you'll become an expert in the platforms that power our targeting, and you'll help shape where our data and reporting go next.

Unisys is a global technology solutions company focused on delivering high-performance, security-centric solutions that improve how people live and work. Our people are at the forefront of everything we do - driving client success, contributing to our communities, and making the world more secure. If you believe in better outcomes and better lives, we would love for you to join us.


What you’ll do:

  • Administer our Marketing Insight and Intelligence tech stack day to day, including Salesforce Data Cloud (Data 360), Intentsify, ZoomInfo, and RingLead, keeping each platform running reliably.
  • Build and activate audiences in Salesforce Data Cloud, troubleshoot issues, and develop deep enough expertise to become the team's go-to resource.
  • Monitor marketing data quality across systems, flag inconsistencies, and help resolve them.
  • Maintain our target account list in partnership with marketing and sales.
  • Build reports and dashboards that turn campaign data into clear, actionable insight.
  • Partner with marketing, sales, and partner/alliances teams to fulfill audience requests for campaigns and programs.
  • Support intent data platforms and vendor relationships to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Support website tagging using Google Tag Manager.
  • Get a front-row seat to our data modernization, including our move to Databricks and Power BI, and help represent marketing's needs as the platform takes shape.
  • Spot manual or inefficient processes and suggest improvements.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

You'll be successful in this role if you have:


  • A BA/BS degree and 2–4 years of experience in marketing operations, sales or revenue operations, marketing analytics, or a related role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 1–2 years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Experience building segments or audiences in a CDP, marketing automation platform, or ad platform (Salesforce Data Cloud a strong plus)
  • Exposure to intent or data enrichment tools such as ZoomInfo, Intensify, 6sense, or Bombora
  • A data-curious mindset: you like finding gaps, asking why, and figuring out the fix
  • Clear communication skills, including explaining data to non-technical stakeholders
  • The ability to work well in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Nice to have: Google Tag Manager, Power BI or Tableau, SQL, or exposure to Databricks, Snowflake, or Azure


Benefits

Unisys offers an outstanding benefits package, featuring unlimited paid time off, a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare, HSA matching, ongoing learning opportunities, and more! We’re committed to supporting work-life balance and investing in your future success.


Video Interview

At Unisys, we incorporate video interviews as a key part of our hiring process. This allows us to get to know you better and provide a more engaging and convenient interview experience. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to connecting with you virtually!

Job Description:

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Digital Dental Sales Specialist (m/w/d) für Süddeutschland zur Verstärkung unseres DEXIS Diagnostics Vertriebsteams in der DACH-Region.


In dieser Schlüsselrolle tragen Sie maßgeblich zur erfolgreichen Vermarktung der DEXIS Diagnostics Produkte bei und unterstützen direkt die Wachstumsziele des Unternehmens in Europa. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem DACH Sales Manager, dem lokalen Marketing Manager sowie dem Regional Key Account Manager setzen Sie Ihre umfassende Expertise in digitalen Workflows sowie Hard- und Softwarelösungen von DEXIS Diagnostics ein, um den Vertrieb über unsere Handelspartner erfolgreich voranzutreiben.


Verantwortungsgebiet: Südwestdeutschland und die Schweiz.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von Produktschulungen und Präsentationen bei strategischen Partnern, Dentallaboren, Enterprise-Kunden sowie Zahnärzten im Rahmen eines Account-Management-Ansatzes.
  • Schulung und Begleitung der Vertriebsteams unserer DEXIS Diagnostics Handelspartner bei Kundenbesuchen, um diese in die Lage zu versetzen, unsere Lösungen erfolgreich zu präsentieren und zu verkaufen.
  • Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, vertrauensvoller Beziehungen zu den Vertriebsteams unserer Distributoren.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Marketing Managern und dem Digital Marketing Team zur Planung und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Nachfrage- und Lead-Generierung.
  • Durchführung von Kundenveranstaltungen wie Messen, Schulungen, Workshops und Webinaren, sowohl direkt im Namen von DEXIS Diagnostics als auch gemeinsam mit unseren Vertriebspartnern.
  • Aktive Nachverfolgung bestehender Verkaufschancen innerhalb der Vertriebspipeline sowie Unterstützung der Distributoren bei der erfolgreichen Umwandlung von Leads in Abschlüsse.
  • Unterstützung der Handelspartner bei Endanwenderschulungen nach dem Verkauf.
  • Mitarbeit bei Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten mit strategischen Kunden und Handelspartnern, einschließlich großer Unternehmensgruppen (z. B. DSO-Strukturen), durch Bereitstellung von Anwendungsexpertise.
  • Dokumentation von Aktivitäten im CRM-System sowie Erstellung von Berichten und Umsatzprognosen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem lokalen Vertriebsmanagement und Business Operations zur Erreichung und Übertreffung der definierten jährlichen Vertriebsziele.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit den globalen Produktmanagement-Teams zur Einholung von Kundenfeedback für bestehende Produkte sowie zur Unterstützung neuer Produktentwicklungen und Markteinführungen.

Job Requirements:

Ihr Profil

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im Bereich Medizintechnik, idealerweise in der dentalen Diagnostik (z. B. Bildgebung, Röntgensysteme oder Intraoralscanner)
  • Technisches Verständnis und praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit digitalen Technologien und Lösungen sind erforderlich
  • Ausgeprägte mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
  • Nachweislich starke Vertriebs- und Verhandlungskompetenzen
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Reisen innerhalb der DACH-Region (ca. 50 % national und international)
  • Dynamische, zielorientierte und selbstmotivierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägten zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Produkte und Lösungen schnell zu verstehen, zu verinnerlichen und überzeugend zu präsentieren
  • Hohes Maß an Professionalität sowie ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung
  • Freude daran, Kunden und Vertriebspartner in technischen Anwendungen zu schulen und zu coachen
  • Starke Fähigkeiten im beratungsorientierten Vertrieb (Consultative Selling)
  • Affinität zu digitalen Lösungen, Softwareanwendungen und innovativen Technologien
  • Ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig erfolgreich zu steuern
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office; Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics ist von Vorteil.

Wenn Sie Ihre Leidenschaft für digitale Technologien mit einer vertriebsorientierten Rolle verbinden möchten und die Zukunft der digitalen Zahnmedizin aktiv mitgestalten wollen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Operating Company:

DEXIS

raw.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101383

Position Overview

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The sales leader you support will rely on you for insight into the number. Autodesk’s sales organization is measured every week on where the year will land. For Global Sales, you will explain that number: what moved, why, what the risk is and what to do about it. You are the Global Sales leader’s source of insight on their forecast, their pipeline and their performance. You work alongside the operations business partner who supports the same leader: they run the operating rhythm, and you bring the analysis and intelligence behind it. You are also the leader’s route into everything else the Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence team produces, from account intelligence to targets and reporting. You work inside their business day to day, using methods and standards shared across the whole sales organization, so results are comparable from one business to the next. This is one of four such roles, one for each major part of the sales organization.


Location: United States (remote). Eastern or Central time zone preferred.

Organization: Revenue Operations


Responsibilities

  • Provide the analysis behind the weekly Global Sales forecast: an independent view of where the quarter and year will land, the commentary, and the risks and upside behind the number submitted to executive leadership
  • Prepare the sales leader for the forecast call and executive review, working with the operations business partner who runs the cadence, with risks, upside and gaps already identified
  • Explain week-over-week movement by cause: new pipeline, slipped and pushed deals, losses, deal size, timing, or a change in judgment
  • Analyze pipeline health: coverage, generation, stage conversion, velocity, slippage and linearity, and whether pipeline is enough for future quarters
  • Identify risk before it appears in reported results, with the evidence and a recommended response
  • Measure and report forecast accuracy and bias for this part of the business
  • Run deep dives by geography, segment, product, route to market and team that end in a decision
  • Provide the insight and analysis for this business’s quarterly business reviews, growth priority reviews and deal reviews, working with the operations business partner
  • Bring recurring needs back to the central team so they are built once and shared across all four businesses


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 8+ years in sales forecasting, pipeline analytics, sales or revenue operations, sales strategy, or commercial finance
  • Experience forecasting and analyzing performance for a large sales organization, including presenting insight to senior sales leaders
  • Strong SQL and advanced reporting skills, with the ability to answer questions in the data in real time
  • Deep working knowledge of Salesforce pipeline data
  • Ability to work with senior sales leaders, including presenting findings that run counter to expectations
  • Comfort working in a matrixed structure alongside operations and finance partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • Revenue intelligence platforms such as Clari, Gong or Aviso
  • Experience embedded within a sales organization rather than supporting it centrally
  • Experience measuring and publishing forecast accuracy and bias
  • Enterprise software or SaaS with subscription, renewal and expansion motions, and direct, partner and e-commerce routes to market

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Direct and manage the daily activities of the Network Architecture and Operations Teams
  • Supervise and mentor network engineers and operations associates, assigning duties, preparing performance reviews, and fostering professional development
  • Act as a primary escalation point for technical and operational issues

Network Design & Engineering:

  • Design, plan, and implement network installation projects, ensuring adherence to technical and operational requirements
  • Develop and enforce network architecture, standards, and policies for LAN, WAN, and telecommunications technologies
  • Conduct capacity planning and network analysis to ensure the scalability and reliability of infrastructure

Vendor & Project Management:

  • Establish and maintain relationships with network-related vendors, ensuring timely support and cost-effective solutions
  • Manage network-related projects, including planning, implementation, and documentation
  • Provide status updates and detailed reports to the IT leadership

Documentation & Training:

  • Maintain and enhance the Firms network information repositories (web, database, SharePoint)
  • Develop and deliver training, internal consultation, and documentation services to applicable teams

Qualification

Experience:

  • Strong experience managing network infrastructure in a mid-to-large enterprise
  • Experience supervising network architecture and operations teams; Strong leadership and team-building capabilities
  • Strong experience with network security, including experience with security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST)

Certifications:

  • Cisco CCNP/CCIE and/or Cisco CCDP preferred; Equivalent experience considered

Technical Skills:

  • Expertise in WAN/LAN technologies, Voice Over IP (VoIP), firewalls, and network monitoring systems
  • Strong understanding of network architecture concepts and operating principles
  • Proficient in data communications, hardware/software integration, and troubleshooting complex network issues
  • Familiar with industry-standard network policies and compliance requirements
  • Proficient in using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation for provisioning and managing network resources
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to gather and analyze information, conclude, and propose solutions

The Ariba System Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, and ongoing support of the SAP Ariba platform to ensure reliable and effective procurement and source-to-pay operations. This role serves as a key liaison between Procurement, Finance, IT, and business users, translating operational requirements into system configurations and process improvements.


The Ariba System Administrator manages user access and permissions, system configurations, workflows, approval rules, master data, integrations, and platform updates. The role troubleshoots system and user issues, coordinates with SAP Ariba support and internal technical teams, supports testing and release activities, and maintains system documentation and controls.


This position also identifies opportunities to improve processes through system optimization, automation, and adoption of Ariba capabilities. The administrator supports end-user training, reporting, compliance, and data quality initiatives while helping ensure the platform remains aligned with business requirements, security standards, and procurement policies.


What You Will Do

  • Serves in lead capacity providing guidance, being a subject expert and an escalation point with regards to buying and invoicing activities
  • Evaluates existing processes and ensures system functionality is effective
  • Translates business requirements into functional documentation of solutions for process improvements, system integrations and analytics

This remote Engagement Ambassador position is Title 1 funded position is responsible for supporting student engagement through regular student conferences/meetings, parent contact, and coaching to address both academic and social-emotional needs. The position will have an assigned caseload of students with the purpose of removing barriers to academic success.

K12, a Stride Company, believes in Education for ANY ONE. We provide families an online option for a high-quality, personalized education experience. Students can thrive, find their passion, and learn in an environment that encourages discovery at their own pace.

This position offers a base salary of $48,000.

Passionate Educators are needed at the Stride K12 partner school, Texas Virtual Academy of Hallsville (TVAH). We want you to be a part of our talented team!

The mission of Texas Virtual Academy of Hallsville (TVAH) is to provide an exemplary individualized and engaging educational experience for students by incorporating school and community/family partnerships coupled with a rigorous curriculum along with a data-driven and student-centered instructional model. Student success will be measured by valid and reliable assessment data, parent and student satisfaction, and continued institutional growth within the academic community. Join us!

This is a full-time REMOTE position. Ability to work independently, typically 40+ hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9-5 (or 8-4) or as defined by the school.

  • Monitor academic progress and activity of students on their caseload;

  • Initiate larger student support interventions when a student begins showing signs of academic decline as determined by course grades, log-ins, course activity and missing assignments;
  • Arrange support conferences as needed to address performance concerns;
  • Assist students in creating plans to get back on track;
  • Provide outreach, training, and support to families who respond to Students First Check In surveys;

  • Participate in State testing as required

raw.description:
Product Designer (UX/UI Designer | SaaS Products & Design Systems)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Brazil, Colombia, Argentina, or Mexico
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Product Designer (UX/UI) to create intuitive, scalable, and user-centered experiences across web and mobile applications.

This is more than a visual design role. You’ll own the end-to-end product design process—from user research and interaction design to design systems and developer handoff. Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you’ll transform user insights into seamless digital experiences that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

If you enjoy solving complex product challenges, designing with systems in mind, and balancing user needs with business goals, this role is an excellent fit.

What You’ll Own

UX Research & Product Discovery

  • Conduct user research, interviews, usability testing, and behavioral analysis.
  • Create personas, journey maps, user flows, and information architecture.
  • Identify friction points and recommend user experience improvements.
  • Use analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar platforms to support design decisions.

UX/UI Design

  • Design wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
  • Create responsive experiences across desktop and mobile applications.
  • Design modern, intuitive user interfaces aligned with SaaS best practices.
  • Deliver production-ready designs using Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch.

Design Systems & Component Libraries

  • Build, maintain, and evolve scalable design systems.
  • Create reusable UI components and design patterns.
  • Define standards for typography, spacing, color, icons, and interactions.
  • Ensure consistency across all products and features.

Accessibility & User Experience

  • Design accessible experiences aligned with WCAG 2.1 standards.
  • Improve usability across devices, browsers, and screen sizes.
  • Create intuitive interfaces that reduce friction and improve engagement.

Product Optimization

  • Conduct A/B testing and usability validation.
  • Analyze user behavior to improve conversion, retention, and engagement.
  • Iterate designs based on customer feedback, analytics, and testing results.

Collaboration & Developer Handoff

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Deliver developer-ready assets using Figma Dev Mode, Zeplin, or similar tools.
  • Provide interaction specifications, annotations, and design documentation.
  • Support implementation to ensure design quality in production.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • User-first mindset with strong product thinking.
  • Excellent problem-solving and UX decision-making skills.
  • Strong visual design skills with attention to detail.
  • Comfortable balancing business objectives with user needs.
  • Collaborative communicator who works effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Passionate about scalable systems, accessibility, and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating:
    • UX problem-solving
    • Product thinking
    • Responsive design
    • High-quality UI execution

Core Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in:
    • Figma
    • Adobe XD
    • Sketch
  • Experience creating:
    • User flows
    • Wireframes
    • Interactive prototypes
    • Design systems
  • Strong understanding of:
    • UX principles
    • Accessibility
    • Responsive design
    • Usability testing

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience designing:
    • SaaS platforms
    • Enterprise software
    • Consumer applications
  • Experience maintaining large-scale design systems.
  • Basic knowledge of:
    • HTML
    • CSS
    • JavaScript
  • Familiarity with:
    • Mixpanel
    • Amplitude
    • Product analytics platforms

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Conduct user research and review product analytics.
  • Design user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity interfaces.
  • Build interactive prototypes and validate design concepts.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers.
  • Expand and maintain design systems.
  • Conduct usability testing and iterate based on user feedback.

In short: You’ll design intuitive, scalable product experiences that improve usability, strengthen customer engagement, and support long-term product growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Improved user satisfaction and usability.
  • Increased product engagement and retention.
  • Reduced friction across key user journeys.
  • On-time delivery of production-ready design assets.
  • Adoption and consistency of design systems.
  • Reduced implementation issues during development.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the end-to-end product design experience.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering teams.
  • Directly influence product usability and customer experience.
  • Build and evolve scalable design systems.
  • Fully remote work environment with long-term growth opportunities.
  • Career progression into:
    • Senior Product Designer
    • Design Lead
    • Head of Design

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Portfolio Review & UX/UI Assessment
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about designing intuitive digital products, enjoy solving complex UX challenges, and excel at creating scalable design systems that improve user experiences, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape products that delight users while driving measurable business impact.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Total Rewards, you will be a key member of the People & Culture leadership team. You won't just manage plans; you will define the Workiva benefits philosophy, ensuring our benefits are a competitive advantage that reflects our commitment to employee wellbeing.

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Global Strategy & Governance: Design and implement a multi-year global benefits roadmap that aligns with our corporate culture and financial objectives.

  • Executive Partnership: Act as a strategic advisor to regional HR leaders and Executive stakeholders, providing data-driven insights into benefit trends and cost-mitigation strategies.

  • Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and develop a high-performing team (currently including an American benefits manager and a benefits analyst.), fostering a culture of professional growth and operational excellence.

  • Fiscal Stewardship: Direct the global benefits budget, leading high-stakes negotiations with brokers and carriers to optimize our "spend-to-value" ratio.

  • Modernization & Innovation: Drive the evolution of our benefits technology stack (Workday) and wellness offerings, ensuring they meet the needs of a diverse global workforce.

Who You Are

  • The Strategist: You don't just look at next year’s renewal; you look at the 3-year trend. You understand how benefits impact the P&L and employee retention.

  • The Globalist: You have deep experience navigating the statutory complexities of the Americas, Europe and APAC while maintaining a cohesive global identity.

  • The Leader: You have a proven track record of managing senior-level individual contributors and helping them "level up" their own strategic thinking.

  • The Communicator: You can take complex actuarial data and turn it into a compelling narrative for the executive team.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years in Total Rewards/Benefits, with at least 5 years in a people manager leadership role within a global, public company (SaaS experience preferred).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or a related field.

  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of global benefit regulations and significant experience with Workday or similar enterprise HCM systems.

  • Consultative Approach: Exceptional ability to influence without authority and build strong partnerships across Finance, Legal, and regional People & Culture teams.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $154,000.00 - $250,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

Responsibilities

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within the United States.

Sargent & Lundy is one of the largest and most experienced power industry engineering and consulting firms. We have a unique and exciting opportunity to join our Consulting group in the role of Electrical Engineer for electrical power projects. We are seeking detail-oriented professionals with power project electrical engineering design experience.

This position is being added to support the continued growth of the Sargent & Lundy Consulting group, particularly in the gas generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, and utility planning / advisory practice areas. Our Consulting group works with clients across the United States and in numerous other countries.

This position will require face-to-face interaction with power plant developers and owners, as well as lenders and investors, during the execution of consulting services work for the firm. The work environment in our Consulting group is fast-paced, dynamic, and interesting.

This position in Sargent & Lundy’s Consulting group will require you participate in our owner’s engineer engagements for utility-scale power generation projects developed by our electric utilities and Independent Power Producer (IPP) clients. Common tasks include:

  • Preparing and/or reviewing EPC RFP packages and associated technical specifications
  • Evaluating EPC proposals to assist selection of preferred EPC contractors
  • Providing technical support during negotiations of EPC contract
  • Preparing or reviewing specifications such as main power transformers, switchgear, and other electrical equipment

    • Simple and combined cycle electrical system design packages
    • Renewable low-voltage (both DC and AC) systems
    • AC collection system for solar and batteries
    • Collector substation and interconnecting substation expansion
    • Gen-tie transmission

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Cecelia Health is a national virtual specialty medical practice serving people with chronic conditions across the care continuum. We expand access to care and provide personalized clinical support to help patients achieve sustained engagement and durable outcomes. Powered by digital tools and uniquely data-enabled, our integrated care approach addresses the whole person with proactive, coordinated support focused on clinical, behavioral, social, and emotional needs across cardiometabolic and related conditions. Following evidence-based guidelines and clinical best practices, our solution is scalable for health plans, providers, health systems, and life sciences.

Position Overview:

Cecelia Health is seeking an experienced Product Manager - Data Integration to support implementation and operational management of customer and partner data integrations across our growing portfolio of clinical programs. The Product Manager will own data integration capabilities that support customer onboarding, patient/member data ingestion, clinical workflows, operational reporting, and analytics. The ideal candidate combines strong data management skills with healthcare interoperability expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality data solutions that directly enable patient care. This is a remote role, and the position is limited to the United States only.

Primary Responsibilities:

Customer-Facing Data Integration Leadership:
  • Serve as product stakeholder for customer data onboarding and integration initiatives.
  • Partner directly with customers, implementation teams, and Customer Success to gather business and technical requirements.
  • Lead testing and validation efforts for inbound and outbound data file exchanges, providing timely review and ensuring successful deployment to production.
  • Translate customer data requirements into scalable product capabilities and technical specifications.
  • Collaborate with implementation teams to ensure successful customer launches and ongoing operations.
  • Participate in customer meetings, implementation reviews, and quarterly business reviews as needed.
Data Standards & Interoperability:
  • Define and maintain enterprise standards for inbound and outbound data exchanges.
  • Establish governance for data formats, field definitions, mapping requirements, validation rules, and business logic.
  • Develop and maintain integration documentation, interface specifications, and data dictionaries.

Data Ingestion & Workflow Enablement:

  • Own product capabilities that support ingestion and management of patient, member, provider, eligibility, claims, laboratory, pharmacy, and device data.
  • Work closely with Clinical Operations to ensure data supports patient identification, outreach, engagement, documentation, and reporting workflows.
  • Ensure data quality, completeness, timeliness, and usability for care teams.
  • Prioritize enhancements that improve clinical efficiency and reduce manual operational processes.

Partner Support & Operational Excellence

  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational workflows for data exchange processes.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective action plans for data quality or integration failures.
  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for automation and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to develop and deliver scalable platform capabilities supporting current and future customer needs.
  • Balance customer-specific requirements with long-term platform standardization goals.
Requirements and Experience:
  • 5+ years of Data Management experience.
  • 3+ years working with healthcare data integrations, interoperability, or healthcare technology platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience managing customer-facing integration projects.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data exchange methods, including sFTP and APIs.
  • Experience working with EHR/EMR systems and healthcare operational workflows.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Experience working in Agile product development environments.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, and Operations teams.
  • Familiarity with eligibility, claims, pharmacy, laboratory, and remote monitoring data.
  • Understanding of HIPAA, PHI, healthcare security, and healthcare compliance requirements.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar product management tools.
  • Must live in the continental United States only
Cecelia Health does not discriminate in employment or applications for employment based on an applicant’s sex, race, color, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, service in the armed forces of the United States, disability, or any other protected classification as outlined by Federal, State or local laws. 

Cecelia Health will never ask you to provide sensitive financial or personal information during recruitment or interviews. We will never extend a job offer without interviewing candidates via phone/video.

Job Summary

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is the executive responsible for protecting the organization's information, technology infrastructure, applications, data, and digital services from cyber threats and security risks.

Within Insurance & Investments, the CISO leads enterprise cybersecurity, information security governance, cyber risk management, security architecture, incident response, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, third-party security, and business continuity/cyber resilience.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the enterprise cybersecurity and information security strategy.

Establish information security policies, standards, controls, and governance frameworks.

Lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk management.

Protect sensitive customer, financial, investment, policyholder, employee, and corporate data.

Security Operations (SOC)

Threat Detection & Response

Incident Response

Security Architecture

Vulnerability Management

Penetration Testing

Identity & Access Management

Endpoint Security

Network Security

Cloud Security

Application Security

Data Security

Lead security monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, and security testing.

Implement and maintain Identity & Access Management (IAM), privileged access, MFA, and least-privilege controls.

Manage security audits, risk assessments, control testing, and remediation programs.

Develop and test Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Cyber Resilience plans.

Establish cybersecurity KPIs, KRIs, dashboards, and executive reporting.

Manage cybersecurity budgets, vendors, managed security providers, and strategic technology partners.

Lead and develop information-security and cybersecurity teams.

The ideal candidate will be driven, intellectually curious, and committed to excellence. This role requires strong analytical skills, real property expertise, and a minimum of 5 years of experience working with or for the DoD on federal planning projects. Please note that this role requires U.S. Citizenship and travel on-site to DoD locations in the U.S. and overseas.

Anticipated work includes:

  • Lead federal planning projects for DoD clients and facilitate successful outcomes.
  • Support project-based DoD client and stakeholder engagement both virtually and in-person.
  • Prepare deliverables, such as Master Plans, Requirements Analyses, Planning Charrette Reports, and Facility Space Plans.
  • Work with Project Managers to organize project teams to ensure deliverables are submitted on time, within scope, and to the client’s satisfaction.

The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Advanced knowledge of federal planning principles, military mission priorities, and DoD real property assets.
  • Proven success leading projects that helped DoD clients achieve their desired planning outcomes.
  • The ability to juggle multiple, concurrent priorities and manage tasks independently.
  • Experience organizing and working with multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Proven quantitative and qualitative analytical skills to effectively convey data-driven planning.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • A track record of submitting high quality deliverables reflective of DoD client goals.

Required qualifications:

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience working with or for the DoD on federal planning projects.
  • Continuous and progressive leadership experience on DoD federal planning projects.
  • Experience using DoD data systems and guidance (please note specific DoD data systems, such as real property systems of record, in your application).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).
  • Availability to travel to DoD sites in the U.S. and overseas (25% of time).
  • U.S. Citizenship.

Preferred qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree (or higher) in urban planning or a related field or equivalent professional planning experience.
  • American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) credentialing.
  • Software skills, such as Esri ArcGIS Suite, AutoCAD, and/or Adobe Suite (please specify in your application).

COMPENSATION

The range for this role is $85,619 – $112,375; this will be dependent on the experience and expertise of the incoming candidate.

THIS POSITION CAN BE REMOTE, OR HYBRID; Periodic On-site Travel to Client Sites (25%) is Required.

Category: Education

Location:


HNO6009-Mental Health Foundations

As an experienced online educator, the candidate will work as an independent contractor of LINC Education to offer online facilitation services for students studying in the Masters of Mental Health (Online) offered by Victoria University Online. Candidate must possess strong knowledge of mental illnesses, their prevalence and impact across diverse communities. They should be able to support students in applying mental health promotion and illness prevention strategies, interpreting legal and ethical frameworks, and understanding recovery-oriented and evidence-based approaches to mental healthcare. The candidate should also demonstrate an understanding of practitioner wellbeing and self-care within mental health practice.

Key Skills Required

  • Mental health and mental ill-health

  • Common mental illnesses

  • Mental health promotion

  • Mental illness prevention

  • Legal and ethical frameworks in mental healthcare

  • Recovery-oriented practice

  • Evidence-based mental health practice

  • Mental health across diverse communities

  • Practitioner self-care

  • Mental healthcare practice

Desired Candidate Profile

  • Registered Nurse or Midwife (AHPRA registration) or Registered Mental Health Practising Nurse and knowledge of unit content.

  • PhD and/or Master Degree in relevant field (i.e. health-related) plus 5 years' relevant teaching, research and/or professional experience in the last 10 years

  • Full rights to work within Australia.

  • An Australian Business Number or ABN as a sole trader, or of the entity that will contract with LINC.

  • Empathetic, ambitious, warm and outgoing personality willing to work closely with people from diverse cultures;

  • Proficient in English language; excellent oral and written communication

  • Must possess a working laptop and have access to high-speed (>10 MBPS) stable internet connection;

  • Ability to quickly learn and use technology platforms for interacting with students, including the host university’s LMS and LINCtrac (training on these platforms will be provided).

The candidate needs to be available between 5 pm to 10 pm every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

LINC Fellows will be responsible for providing:

  1. Subject matter guidance to a group of 25-30 undergraduate online students;

  2. Support in learning skills like academic writing, research and time management;

  3. Conduct 1:1 sessions for doubt-resolution, academic guidance and assessment draft reviews

  4. Guidance on relevant reference material;

  5. Assessment marking with long-form feedback

  6. Management of discussion forums; and

  7. Proactive, prompt and personalised support to student queries and issues.

LINC Fellows will be expected to promptly interact with students over email, or calls / online sessions from locations of their convenience (e.g. home, office etc.).

Corporate:
Light & Wonder’s corporate team is comprised of incredible talent that works across the enterprise, defying boundaries to provide essential services in an extraordinary manner to ensure the success of the organization and the well-being of employees.

Position Summary

Looking to grow your HR career in a role that’s dynamic, people-focused, and full of variety? As an Associate Specialist in our HR Shared Service Team (known internally as the People Solution Center or PSC), you’ll be the go-to partner for our Creators across the U.S. No two days are the same; you’ll be solving problems, answering questions, and helping shape a smooth employee experience from start to finish. If you’re energized by fast-paced work, love connecting with people, and want to make an impact across the Americas, this role is for you!

The People Solution Center Americas supports ~3,000 employees across six countries, providing world-class HR services with a focus on accuracy, responsiveness, and care. We manage HR processes, policies, and employee data in Workday, while serving as trusted partners to employees and managers alike. This role reports to the Manager, PSC - Americas.

What You’ll Do:

  • Be the first point of contact for HR questions, from policies to processes.

  • Provide accurate, helpful support with empathy and a people-first mindset.

  • Investigate and resolve employee concerns, escalating when needed and always following up.

  • Keep employee records clean and up to date in Workday; pull reports when needed.

  • Spot opportunities to improve how we work - and share your ideas.

  • Deliver high-quality HR transactions and support in line with service levels.

  • Support hiring and onboarding after the offer stage - contracts, background checks, and getting new hires ready for Day One.

  • Conduct compliance checks (think: right-to-work, policy audits, and documentation).

  • Jump in on projects that make our People Solution Center even better.

What You Bring:

  • Real-world HR experience (bonus points if you’ve supported employees directly).

  • Comfortable navigating employee questions and solving day-to-day HR challenges.

  • Experience with HRIS systems, Workday is a big plus.

  • Able to manage multiple tasks and shift gears quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications

  • Education: A bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or a related field is great, but equivalent experience works too!

  • Experience: 1–2 years in HR or a people-focused role (customer service counts, if you’ve solved problems and supported people, we want to hear from you).

  • Systems: Comfortable with HRIS systems; bonus points if you’ve clicked around Workday before.

  • Skills: Strong communicator, organized multitasker, and natural problem-solver who can roll with change in a fast-paced environment.

  • Mindset: Trusted with sensitive information, and you handle it with integrity and care.

Your Superpowers:

  • Empathy & Communication: You listen well, respond thoughtfully, and know how to connect with people.

  • Collaboration: You love being part of a team and working cross-functionally.

  • Cultural Awareness: You value inclusion and different perspectives, and it shows.

  • Problem-Solving: You think critically, stay calm under pressure, and find smart solutions.

  • Proactive Energy: You don’t wait for answers, you dig in, take initiative, and make things happen.

  • Integrity: You handle sensitive info with care, discretion, and professionalism.

Why Join Us?

You’ll be part of a global People team that’s always evolving. We’re building better HR; not just for today, but for the future. Expect variety, impact, and a team that genuinely supports each other.

Our Perks:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

  • 3 weeks’ Vacation and Holidays (about 11 a year)

  • HSA or FSA account and other voluntary benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with Employer Match Program

Light & Wonder and its affiliates (collectively, “L&W”) are engaged in highly regulated gaming and lottery businesses. As a result, certain L&W employees may, among other things, be required to obtain a gaming or other license(s), undergo background investigations or security checks, or meet certain standards dictated by law, regulation or contracts. In order to ensure L&W complies with its regulatory and contractual commitments, as a condition to hiring and continuing to employ its employees, L&W requires all of its employees to meet those requirements that are necessary to fulfill their individual roles. As a prerequisite to employment with L&W (to the extent permitted by law), you shall be asked to consent to L&W conducting a due diligence/background investigation on you.

This job description should not be interpreted as all-inclusive; it is intended to identify major responsibilities and requirements of the job. The employee in this position may be requested to perform other job-related tasks and responsibilities than those stated above.

¿Busca hacer crecer tu carrera de recursos humanos en un puesto dinámico, centrado en las personas y lleno de variedad? Como Associate Specialist, en nuestro equipo de servicios compartidos de recursos humanos (conocido internamente como People Solution Center o PSC), serás el punto de contacto clave para nuestros creadores en México, Argentina, Panamá, Perú y Estados Unidos. Cada día será diferente; resolverás problemas, responderás preguntas y ayudarás a crear una experiencia eficiente y fluida para los empleados de principio a fin. Si te motiva trabajar en un entorno activo y desafiante, disfrutas conectar con personas y estás listo para generar un impacto real en toda la región de América, este puesto está hecho para ti.

· Brindarás soporte en el proceso de contratación, así como la incorporación a la empresa después del proceso de oferta laboral incluyendo, contratos, verificaciones de antecedentes y preparación de nuevas contrataciones para el primer día.

· Conducirás verificaciones de cumplimiento (derecho al trabajo, auditorías de políticas y documentación).

· Participarás en proyectos que hacen que nuestro People Solution Center sea aún mejor.

Con qué debes contar:

· Cómodo atendiendo consultas de empleados y resolviendo desafíos cotidianos de recursos humanos.

· Curiosidad y entusiasmo por conocer el amplio panorama de beneficios de la región de América.

· Resolución de problemas: Piensas críticamente, mantienes la calma bajo presión y encuentras soluciones inteligentes.

· Energía proactiva: No esperas respuestas, profundizas, tomas la iniciativa y haces que las cosas sucedan.

· Integridad: manejas la información confidencial con cuidado, discreción y profesionalismo.

¿Por qué unirse con nosotros?

Formarás parte de un equipo global, enfocado en el cumplimiento de la misión de la empresa y en constante evolución. Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.


We support 100% remote work for this role!


We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Senior Manager, Commerce Media, you will lead commerce media strategy and activation for a broader slice of accounts while managing and developing a team of Commerce individual contributors. You’ll be accountable for consistent, high‑quality delivery across retail media platforms (e.g., Amazon, Walmart, Criteo and similar), and for raising the team’s craft in planning, testing, measurement‑informed optimization, and client communication. You’ll stay hands‑on where it matters most (major launches, complex troubleshooting, high‑stakes client moments), while spending more of your time coaching, reviewing, standardizing best practices, and partnering cross‑functionally so commerce media work is integrated into the broader client strategy.

Key Responsibilities:

People Leader:

  • Build and lead a strong team: set clear goals, run regular 1:1s, provide coaching and feedback, and develop career paths for both emerging and more senior talent (IC and manager tracks).
  • Review and elevate the quality of client‑facing outputs across your slice (plans, performance narratives, testing agendas, readouts), ensuring work is defensible and consistent.
  • Lead hiring and talent evaluation for your area: participate in interviewing, define role‑ready skill expectations, and provide recommendations for promotions, stretch assignments, and targeted development.
  • Promote cross‑training to build bench strength and flexibility (e.g., Amazon Search + DSP, Walmart + Amazon, onsite + offsite patterns), partnering with Talent Development and senior leaders as needed.

Client-Centric:

  • Own integrated commerce media planning and execution across your client accounts, ensuring strategies ladder to client business objectives (growth, profitability, retention, new‑to‑brand/customer acquisition where applicable).
  • Lead or co‑lead commerce media portions of senior client touchpoints: explain what’s happening, why it matters, and what you recommend next with clear trade‑offs and expectations.
  • Ensure commerce media work connects to broader full‑funnel and cross‑channel plans (Search, Social, TVAD, Creative, CRM, Retail/Marketplace strategy), partnering with Client Partners and channel leads to align priorities and timing.

Channel Specific Expertise & The Tinuiti Way:

  • Standardize how your teams plan, execute, and report across retail media: launch readiness, QA discipline, pacing hygiene, change logs, and clear documentation so quality is repeatable.
  • Own the implementation of Commerce Media Tinuiti Way for your clients: enforce practical standards and coaching for platform roles, retail event playbooks, and day‑to‑day operational excellence.
  • Create a strong collaboration cadence across adjacent teams so commerce media isn’t siloed; ensure teams understand dependencies and handoffs.

Product-Led:

  • Drive team-wide proficiency in Tinuiti tools and core commerce platforms; ensure the team uses technology, automation, and (where appropriate) AI to improve speed, consistency, and insight quality.
  • Sponsor adoption of reusable templates and workflows (brief intake, launch checklists, reporting views, testing templates) to reduce manual work and rework.
  • Collect structured platform and workflow feedback from the field and route it to senior commerce leadership and product/ops partners, prioritizing issues that unlock scale and reduce friction.

Data & Measurement Data-Driven:

  • Ensure teams use data to make decisions, not just report: diagnose drivers (pacing, CPC/CPA, ROAS/ACoS, NTB, share‑of‑voice/brand signals where available), surface trade‑offs, and recommend actions with simple success criteria.
  • Set expectations for testing rigor and learning loops: clear hypotheses, clean setups, defined read timing, and documentation of what changed and what we learned.
  • Oversee measurement alignment and ensure learnings roll back into next‑cycle plans.

Owner Mindset:

  • Love Growth: Identify and scale growth plays across multiple client accounts (new formats, retail event strategies, audience expansion patterns, creative/placement learnings) and turn wins into reusable playbooks.
  • Hate Waste: Reduce recurring waste patterns (inefficient spend, repeated QA errors, slow reaction to pacing issues, poor inventory patterns) by installing standards, safeguards, and coaching that sticks.
  • Lead 1–2 cross‑account initiatives per half that improve commerce media consistency or efficiency (e.g., QA upgrades, reporting standardization, testing ladders, retail event readiness processes).

Professional & Technical Qualifications:

  • 7–10+ years in commerce media / retail media / paid commerce, including meaningful experience across major retail media ecosystems (e.g., Amazon and/or Walmart plus others).
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams (ICs and potentially first‑line managers), including performance management, QA oversight, and capability building.
  • Strong command of commerce media optimization and measurement concepts (ROAS/ACoS, NTB where available, incrementality concepts, experimentation basics, retail seasonality/event dynamics).
  • Demonstrated ability to standardize ways of working across multiple accounts and maintain high quality under changing priorities.
  • Strong communication and executive-ready storytelling skills; able to translate complex performance drivers into clear actions and expectations for clients and internal leadership.

The hiring salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000. We also offer an incentive pay program (RevShare) comprising a monthly variable revenue payment opportunity and a discretionary annual performance bonus.

Provider Credentialing Analyst

ArchWell Health is a new, innovative healthcare provider devoted to improving the lives of our senior members. Our members experience greater continuity of care, as well as the comfort of knowing they will be treated with respect by people who genuinely care about them, their families, and their communities. This hire will partner with current credentialing staff and own the end-to-end credentialing process, including: submitting and tracking credentialing applications to various contracted managed care plans and government payors for oncoming providers; maintaining the data for all providers within the group; tracking the expiration of certification and licenses; and will act as a liaison between payors, external credentialing service firms, and medical staff, including physicians.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Must understand Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plan credentialing requirements and must be familiar with CAQH (Council for Affordable Quality Healthcare)

Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We’re looking for enthusiastic Remote Customer Service Agent to support a range of customer service initiatives for a diverse portfolio of well-known clients. In this role, you’ll assist customers with enquiries and provide excellent service.

Summary of Position


The Senior Director of Engineering for Registration and Enrollment leads the strategy, vision, and execution of Teladoc's enrollment and eligibility ecosystem. This leader is responsible for ensuring members can successfully enroll in services, verify eligibility, and gain access to the appropriate healthcare benefits through seamless, scalable, and reliable experiences. The role oversees multiple engineering teams and partners closely with Product, Client Solutions, Analytics, Data Science, and external stakeholders to optimize member activation, onboarding completion, and conversion outcomes.

This position requires a seasoned engineering leader who can operate strategically while driving the execution of highly scalable platforms that support payer, employer, and healthcare partner integrations.

  • Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for Enrollment, Eligibility Verification, Benefits Access, and Member Activation.
  • Define and execute the long-term technology strategy for enrollment and eligibility platforms.
  • Drive exceptional onboarding experiences that maximize enrollment completion and member activation rates.
  • Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Data Science, Client Management, and Strategy teams to improve acquisition funnels and member onboarding outcomes.
  • Ensure platform performance, reliability, data quality, compliance, and operational excellence.
  • Establish architectural standards that support future growth and evolving business requirements.
  • Provide leadership to Senior Managers and engineering teams across onshore and offshore delivery models.

Yes

raw.description:
At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture. With 80+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably. We're looking for bold thinkers, builders, technologists, and sellers who want real ownership of their work, thrive in collaborative environments, and are energized by solving complex challenges. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact - fast. If you're eager to shape the future of cross-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.

We are seeking a versatile product analytics team member to support our growing product and engineering teams. In this role, you will help drive rapid, data-driven insights to inform product decisions around experiments, features, and product direction related to our core money transfer digital product. This is a full-time remote position open to candidates based in the US, offering the opportunity to work globally and influence product strategy across multiple areas of MoneyGram's product and technology offerings. What you will get to do as Senior, Data Analyst – Product Analytics

  • Analytics Re-Invention: AI has become the fundamental building block of many new platforms built in the last few years. You are willing to go beyond anything you've ever done before and rethink analytics from the ground up. "It's been done this way before" is not a benefit, but a defect.
  • Customer Experience and Product Performance: Craft and evolve the view of the customer experience through analytics and product metrics.
  • Experimentation & Optimization: Support and guide experimental frameworks (A/B tests, holdouts, geo testing, etc.) to measure the incremental impact of product presentation and feature releases. Partner with product and engineering to design data-driven insights that accelerate performance and growth. Provide stakeholders with the ability to measure the success of feature or functionality rollouts by pulling and organizing data into cohorts and measuring metrics based on cohort performance.
  • Insights & Reporting: Analyze and develop key insights into partner and customer behaviors and pain points to uncover opportunities for an improved experience.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams — from Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Regional/International teams — to align analytics initiatives with business goals. Use data to advise on go-to-market strategies for new product launches and to identify new growth opportunities and solutions to business challenges.
  • Technology & Automation: Champion best-in-class analytics tools and processes. Work with Product, Engineering, and Data Engineering to implement and leverage analytics platforms (BI tools, tag management, automation via APIs) that enhance product efficiency and scale. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies in product analytics, continuously seeking opportunities to improve our capabilities and methodologies.

What you will need to be successful

  • Product Analytics Expertise: 3–5+ years of experience in analytics or a related quantitative field, with meaningful focus on product analytics in a B2C or technology-driven company. Demonstrated ability to drive insights that directly inform product strategy and user experience.
  • Technical Skills: Strong hands-on skills in data analysis. Proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets. Familiarity with analytics programming is a plus.
  • Data Visualization Skills: Strong experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools; Looker preferred, or similar BI platforms.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Analytical thinker with an understanding of experiment design. Able to uncover insights from data and translate them into actionable recommendations and measurable results.
  • Communication & Influence: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to distill technically complex data findings into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. Skilled at visual representation of insights, documenting, and presenting findings to stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Comfortable working cross-functionally and with stakeholders across the organization. Ability to build strong relationships with team members and technical partners and advise or partner with colleagues across varying backgrounds.
  • High-Growth & Global Experience: Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth, and ambiguous environment. Global experience and the ability to shape insights for a global audience is highly valued.
  • Industry Background: Experience in direct-to-consumer online businesses is preferred; fintech or financial services experience is a strong. A passion for evolving products and using data to enhance the customer experience is essential.
  • Education: Bachelor's or equivalent practical experience in analytics. An advanced degree or relevant industry certifications in analytics is a bonus.

Join us to shape a data-driven product strategy and drive efficient, rapid growth at scale. If you are excited about building a world-class product analytics function and unlocking new growth opportunities with data, we'd love to hear from you.

The salary/pay rate listed below is a good faith determination that may be offered to a successful applicant for this position at the time of this job advertisement based on the company hiring process and budget for this role and may be modified in the future. Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, and/or skill level. Here Are Some Reasons You Will Love Working At MoneyGram!

  • Remote first flexibility
  • Generous PTO
  • 13 Paid Holidays
  • Medical / Dental / Vision Insurance
  • Life, Disability, and other benefits
  • 401k with competitive Employer Match
  • Community Service Days
  • Generous Parental Leave

MoneyGram does not sponsor US work authorizations for this job position including H-1Bs, O-1, and TN. MoneyGram also does not hire F-1s working on EAD for this position. About MoneyGram MoneyGram is a global payments network built to move money across borders with speed, simplicity and trust. Its omnichannel platform empowers consumers, developers and agents to transfer cash, fiat and stablecoin however it works best for them. The company serves over 50 million customers a year across 200+ countries and territories, nearly half a million retail locations and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem reaching billions of devices. As one of the most recognized and trusted names in global payments, MoneyGram continues to reinvent how money moves - helping people around the world support their loved ones and build better futures. If you love cars, trucks, and their parts, are knowledgeable and have experience delivering training, we have an opportunity for you to join the most recognized brand in the automotive aftermarket. NAPA is known for our Know How, what’s yours?

The Role:

Do you love cars, trucks and all things automotive aftermarket? Do adult learning programs and facilitating training get you excited each day? If this sounds like you, we are looking for a dynamic Autotech Technical Trainer to join our training team! NAPA Auto Parts proudly supports many of our Major Account partnerships by providing top-of-the line Autotech training. Our Autotech Trainers deliver training to AutoCare and Major Account shop employees to increase automotive diagnostic skills and decrease comebacks and parts returns, which in turn increases sales of NAPA parts and equipment.

This awesome role plays a major part on our Autotech Training team and reports to a very supportive Regional Training Manager

This Role may be for you if you:

  • Know the importance of connecting with your training audience
  • Embrace and have put into practice adult learning programs
  • Are enthusiastic about training and presenting to others
  • Successfully develop effective partnerships with major accounts and shop employees, and collaborate well with internal training teams on effective training
  • Have been a go-to resource/creative mind for training teams for all things automotive training

Major ‘parts’ of this awesome role (what you’ll be doing):

  • Continually develops knowledge and skills needed to be an effective automotive/truck instructor by studying available information, attending train-the-trainer sessions, doing hands-on work, taking appropriate online or live classes, involvement in automotive, truck and / or training-related groups, etc.
  • Prepares extensively for classes and provides outstanding delivery, professional interaction with students, and subject matter presentations using adult learning principles
  • Develops training schedules with management and the NAPA Training Service Center. Speaks with division and national departments to determine needs, designs schedules to meet those needs, and adjusts, as necessary
  • Partners with division management to implement, pilot, and facilitate NAPA Autotech training programs
  • Participates and assists in initial course/curriculum development, delivers to test group, solicits feedback on changes needed, and adjusts content and delivery accordingly
  • Ensures course content integrity while allowing for freedom to enhance the learner's experience based on instructor's style
  • Works closely with internal and external customers to determine training needs and plan training events to meet those needs
  • Communicates feedback regarding training events, process, and materials to Training management, course designers, and customers as needed
  • Participates in planning processes (e.g., needs assessment, course development, and delivery)
  • Assists with marketing training events to maximize participation including getting to know DC/store personnel in assigned markets. Assists in marketing training offering / services, initiating engagement and follow-up with targeted audience, and provide any feedback received to NAPA Autotech management
  • Makes training presentations at marketing and owners' conferences, Team NAPA meetings, DC sales meetings, and other NAPA events as required
  • Corresponds with management about training activities, test results, and evaluations
  • Identifies areas of improvement, suggests training courses to correct, and follows up with customer evaluations to determine success of programs
  • Maintains course integrity as designed with some freedom to enhance the learner's experience based on learner's needs and instructor's style
  • Advocates proper selection and qualification of participants by reinforcing appropriateness for the audience. Accomplishes this by ensuring any required prerequisites and/or pre-seminar material is communicated and sent to participants
  • Ensures an effective learning environment for participants including having proper meeting room setup, automotive equipment, and ordering materials
  • Advocates NAPA, the NAPA organization, programs, parts and tools and equipment.
  • Prepares and ensures administrative aspects of training are completed in a timely manner such as participant roster, evaluations, tests, class booklets, handouts, forms, expense reports, A/V equipment, etc.
  • Responsible for performing any other duties as assigned by management

Skills/background you will need to bring to this role:

  • ASE Master Technician Certification required. *no wiggle room on this one, we really need you to have this
  • Minimum 5 years' experience as a working automotive technician - independent repair shop or an OE dealership would be great
  • Prior automotive, truck or related training, facilitation, and meeting direction experience
  • Prior experience (2+ years) successfully conducting adult learning programs
  • High School Diploma, or equivalent experience, required
  • Possesses excellent communication, facilitation, and human relations skills
  • Possess high character, team orientation/fairness, excellent organizational skills and accurate and timely reporting
  • Minimum 70% travel required
  • Ability to stand and talk for 4+ hours at a time with occasional breaks
  • Heavy physical activities may be required (e.g.: lifting training props weighing up to 70 lbs. including cases with parts or tools, using lifting/moving tools to assist with heavier items – daily)
  • Maintains and protects assigned equipment, vehicle, computers, credit cards and other assets

And if you have these skills, even better:

  • NAPA product line knowledge is a plus (not a deal-breaker if you don’t)

What’s in it for you “The perks” (we know you want to know this):

  • Remote work
  • Company vehicle
  • Cell-phone stipend
  • Great total benefits package!
  • Company Culture of direct access to leadership team
  • Awesome people and brand to work with
  • Outstanding health benefits and 401K
  • Stable company. Fortune 200 with a “family” feel
  • A Culture of promotion from within, using your creativity, finding solutions/fixes, and where no 2 days or career paths are the same!
  • Great training, and ongoing development with support from multiple leaders/your team

If this role sounds like a fit, please take the time to complete our super quick and easy application. We are excited and humbled that you are considering NAPA as hopefully your future employer.

Next Steps:

Please apply if you think this is a great fit for you and we will be in touch! If you decide that this role is not for you, please check out some of our other great careers by visiting jobs.genpt.com

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by joining our Talent Community onor create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!
