raw.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with expertise in infrastructure as code (IaC) and modern deployment tools for both cloud and on-premises environments.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in multi-cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) with a focus on Microsoft Azure services.

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing scalable, highly available infrastructure using cutting-edge DevOps practices and tools.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Configuration Management

  1. Develop and maintain infrastructure using IaC tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, and Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates

  2. Implement configuration management using tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef to ensure consistency across environments

  3. Version control all infrastructure code using Git and implement GitOps practices

Cloud and On-Premises Infrastructure Management

  1. Design, deploy, and manage services across multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and on-premises environments

  2. Optimize resource utilization, cost, and performance in both cloud and on-premises infrastructures

  3. Implement hybrid cloud solutions, ensuring seamless integration between on-premises and cloud resources

Containerization and Orchestration

  1. Design and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes

  2. Set up and maintain Kubernetes clusters on cloud platforms (e.g., AKS, EKS, GKE) and on-premises (e.g., Rancher, OpenShift)

  3. Implement service mesh solutions like Istio or Linkerd for advanced traffic management and security

CI/CD and Automation

  1. Design and implement robust CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions

  2. Automate build, test, and deployment processes for both frontend and backend applications

  3. Develop custom scripts and tools to automate routine tasks and improve operational efficiency

Monitoring, Logging, and Observability

  1. Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, and cloud-native monitoring services

  2. Design and maintain logging infrastructures that provide insights across the entire application stack

  3. Implement distributed tracing solutions for complex, microservices-based architectures

Security and Compliance

  1. Implement security best practices in IaC, including encryption, access controls, and network security

  2. Ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2) through automated security checks and audits

  3. Implement and manage secrets management solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault)

Performance Optimization and Scalability

  1. Design and implement auto-scaling solutions for applications and infrastructure

  2. Optimize application performance through caching, CDN implementation, and database tuning

  3. Conduct load testing and implement performance improvements based on results

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

  1. Work closely with development teams to implement DevOps best practices and foster a culture of continuous improvement

  2. Provide training and documentation on modern DevOps tools and practices

  3. Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical decision-making processes

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  1. 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles

  2. Strong proficiency in at least one IaC tool (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates)

  3. Extensive experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  4. Proven experience managing multi-cloud environments, with a focus on Microsoft Azure

  5. Strong scripting skills in languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash

  6. Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and practices

  7. Solid understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, and load balancing

  8. Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack)

  9. Familiarity with Agile and DevOps methodologies

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, CKA)

  2. Experience with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd)

  3. Knowledge of infrastructure security best practices and compliance standards

  4. Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools (e.g., Flux, Argo CD)

  5. Experience with chaos engineering and site reliability practices

  6. Contributions to open-source projects or personal tech blog

What We Offer

  1. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and shape the future of our infrastructure

  2. Continuous learning and development opportunities

  3. Collaborative and innovative work environment

  4. Competitive salary and benefits package

  5. Remote work options available

Join our team and play a crucial role in driving our technological advancement through modern DevOps practices!

Benefits

  • Performance-based Bonuses and Increments:Monthly retroactive bonuses and increments based on performance, plus Eid bonuses.
  • Global Exposure and Travel Opportunities: International travel opportunities for high-performing employees driving hypergrowth.
  • Meals and Snacks:Complimentary breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, fruits, and beverages provided daily.
  • Paid Cool-off Period:Performance-based paid time off for rest and rejuvenation.
  • Work Environment: A high-performance, resilient workspace equipped with the fastest internet in Pakistan.
  • Healthcare and Wellness:Comprehensive medical insurance, treatment, and care for employees.
  • Overnight Stay Facilities:Access to sleeping pods and personal lockers for late-night work.
  • Recreational Activities:Team trips and recreational events.
  • Wellness Amenities: High-end massage chairs for relaxation.
  • Gaming and Entertainment:A gaming corner with a PS5.
  • Knowledge Resources:Access to a mini-library for learning and growth.
  • Parking:Insured parking space available for employees.
  • Employee Support: Dedicated support team for employee facilitation.
  • Professional Assistance: Taxation, accounting, and legal assistance provided to employees.

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. AIDA Recruitment is a partner for technology-sector companies. We recruit IT specialists globally and use digital tools to work efficiently and deliver strong outcomes for both clients and candidates.

raw.description:
SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.

Job Description Summary:

The Design Engineer II, Transmission owns the preliminary transmission line design and engineering lifecycle for assigned utility-scale solar, BESS, and related interconnection projects. This role serves as the primary technical owner from BD kickoff through Design-to-Preconstruction handoff, aligning preliminary design, scope, schedule, risk, and technical assumptions before execution begins.

This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Job Description:

*This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned


Position Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Preliminary Transmission Line Design and Technical Ownership
    • Own the first-pass preliminary transmission line and gen-tie design approach for assigned pursuits and projects by reviewing all applicable requirements and project-specific inputs to define the design basis, key assumptions, route and point of interconnection requirements, line configuration, conductor and shield wire assumptions, structure and foundation assumptions, clearances, quantities, risks, and open items needed to support the 10% design deliverable.
    • Review client provided documents, technical exhibits, PPAs, interconnection agreements, utility and ISO handbooks, owner standards, and related project information to identify requirements, assumptions, risks, opportunities, and scope outside of SOLV standards.
    • Serve as the primary transmission line subject matter expert for assigned projects and coordinate technical inputs from engineering consultants, survey and geotechnical teams, environmental and permitting teams, land and right-of-way stakeholders, substation design, procurement, estimating, scheduling, utilities, and other specialty subcontractors.
    • Lead development of the 10% transmission line design, including routing, conductor and structure sizing, and related refinements, to support estimating with pricing.
  • Estimate and Scope Alignment
    • Coordinate with estimating and scheduling to ensure the preliminary transmission line design, route length, structure quantities, conductor and hardware assumptions, scope narrative, schedule, and commercial assumptions are aligned.
    • Review estimates for technical completeness and identify gaps, exclusions, owner-furnished equipment, allowances, contingencies, route or point of interconnection uncertainty, and scope items that require clarification or escalation.
    • Deliver the owner reviewed preliminary transmission line design to estimating and BD in accordance with the project stage-gate schedule.
  • Client and Project Engagement
    • Participate in routine client meetings to review technical exhibits, explain preliminary transmission line design assumptions, identify risks, and clarify route, point of interconnection, utility, and other requirements outside of SOLV standards.
    • Support contractual exhibit reviews, markups, and technical responses needed to facilitate LNTP, while escalating material commitments, non-standard requirements, and significant risk.
    • Communicate transmission line design decisions, open items, risks, and required owner or utility inputs clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • EOR and Engineering Consultant Coordination
    • Prepare and issue proposal requests to transmission line EORs and engineering subcontractors.
    • Review received proposals for technical scope, deliverables, exclusions, assumptions, and commercial alignment.
    • Align EOR and subcontractor proposals with the project scope, route and point of interconnection assumptions, estimate, schedule, and LNTP requirements, and submit the final proposal information to BD, scheduling, estimating, engineering controls, and other required stakeholders.
  • Handoff and Early Execution Readiness
    • Prepare the transmission line engineering scope, proposal information, schedule inputs, EOR or consultant coordination details, route and point of interconnection assumptions, risks, and open items needed for handoff to the Preconstruction Engineering team.
    • Support the handoff process by clearly transferring RFIs, client and utility comments, design risks, procurement constraints, required decisions, and unresolved technical items to the HV engineering team.
  • Quality Assurance, Value Engineering, and Documentation
    • Review and approve preliminary transmission line design deliverables for assigned projects and verify alignment with NESC, IEEE, utility, ISO, owner, SOLV, AHJ, and vendor requirements.
    • Propose cost-effective, reliable, and constructible alternatives for route selection, conductor and shield wire, structure systems, foundations, crossings, access, and point of interconnection interfaces, and resolve design challenges in collaboration with internal teams, EORs, consultants, vendors, and clients.
    • Maintain accurate documentation of route evaluations, design iterations, technical decisions, client and utility comments, proposal revisions, assumptions, risks, and handoff materials.
    • Use established checklists and standards, identify recurring issues, and recommend improvements for incorporation into department processes and standards.
  • Team Leadership and Development
    • Assign and coordinate work for transmission line designers, engineers, interns, and technical support staff on assigned projects; review work for quality, completeness, and schedule compliance.
    • Mentor junior team members and identify training or development needs related to transmission line routing, line design criteria, conductor and structure selection, clearances, utility requirements, RFP review, estimating support, and project handoff.

Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, civil, or related engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) licensure or equivalent certification is a nice-to-have, not a must.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in transmission line design or engineering, utility-scale renewable energy, gen-tie, or related power engineering.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in transmission line design software (PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, PLS-TOWER, AutoCAD, MicroStation, GIS, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of transmission line design principles, routing, conductor and shield wire selection, sag-tension, clearances, structure systems, foundations, and industry standards (NESC, IEEE, etc).
  • Thorough understanding of local, state, and federal regulations related to transmission line design, utility infrastructure, and solar development.
  • Familiarity with utility interconnection requirements, point of interconnection requirements, right-of-way and permitting considerations, and contract language.
  • In-depth knowledge of applicable engineering principles and industry best practices.
  • Effective communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.

The Brink’s Company (NYSE:BCO) is a leading global provider of cash and valuables management, digital retail solutions, and ATM managed services. Our network of operations in 51 countries serves customers in more than 100 countries.

We believe in building partnerships that secure commerce and doing that requires fostering an engaged culture that values people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives. We build a sense of belonging, so all employees feel respected, safe, and valued, and we provide equal opportunity to participate and grow.

Job Description

The Sr. Manager of Customer Operational Excellence - Financial Institutions, provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for Brink’s Customer Operations group. This role champions the execution of customer-centric strategies, aligning claims, metrics, and service processes with the organization’s mission, vision, values, and strategic plan. The Sr. Manager will lead end-to-end service delivery, ensuring exceptional customer experiences through cross-functional collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and team development.

National Product

  • Ensure successful implementation by project teams.

Regional Vice Presidents

Regional Continuous Improvement

Account Executive

  • Resolve major service escalations.
  • Develop and execute interim contracts and renewals.
  • Determine feasibility and effort (i.e., cost) of new business and oversee implementation.

National Continuous Improvement

  • Drive process improvements and efficiencies related to both back-office activities and service delivery.

Critical Competencies

  • Strategic Management – Identifies and executes on strategic opportunities with existing customers to strengthen relationships, increase revenue, and reduce Brink’s cost to serve.
  • Brink’s Organizational Acumen – Coordinates and influences internal stakeholders across multiple functions.
  • Project Management – Organizes, manages, and tracks the status of customer projects, including new business implementations and optimizations.
  • Brink’s Operational Knowledge – Possesses working knowledge of operations across key lines of business (CIT, CVS, ATM, CSF).

  • Customer Interaction Skills – Communicates with stakeholders at all levels in a highly responsive and professional manner.

Qualifications


Minimum:

  • 10+ years of professional experience.

Preferred:

  • Master’s degree.

  • Experience managing customer care operations in financial, banking, or logistics settings.

Professional Skills

  • Strong consultative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to build and sustain strong relationships across all levels of the organization and with external partners.

raw.title: Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) – Full-Time, Remote
raw.excerpt: About Wellity Health Wellity Health provides outpatient mental health care for Southern California and the greater bay area, with a focus on underserved populations in-person and via telehealth.
raw.description:
About Wellity Health
Wellity Health provides outpatient mental health care for Southern California and the greater bay area, with a focus on underserved populations in-person and via telehealth. As a fully remote PMHNP, you'll join that team, working closely with therapists, our supervising psychiatrist, and administrative staff who manage scheduling and billing.

Our Values and Goals
We're committed to true equity in mental health: equitable, accessible care for people from all backgrounds. Our goals are to reduce symptom severity, reduce or eliminate the need for higher levels of care, and foster lasting positive outcomes for our adolescent clients and their loved ones.

We pride ourselves on a management style and workplace culture that is respectful, understanding, and collaborative, while always prioritizing the well-being and effective treatment of our clients.

Job at a Glance

  • Location: Full-time, fully remote. Open to candidates licensed in CA, residing in CA, NM, NV, FL, or TX.
  • Pay: $165,000 - $180,000 per year, depending on experience. This is a true salary, not pay per session.
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9am - 6pm Pacific Time with a one-hour lunch. An alternative Monday-Thursday schedule is available. Remote doesn't mean "set your own schedule": our NPs work a consistent, structured weekly schedule that ensures continuity of care and team collaboration.
  • Benefits: PTO, health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a 401(k), available after a short waiting period
  • Support: Dedicated staff handle client billing and scheduling, so your time goes to clinical work.

Is this the right fit? What matters most

  1. You're comfortable with our pay and scheduling model. We pay a stable salary no matter how many sessions you conduct. In exchange, busy days can be full, so we're looking for someone who isn't afraid of a high client load and values predictable pay, a regular schedule, benefits, and the flexibility of working from home.
  2. You're reliable and dedicated to your clients. You show up fully and consistently, and our clients and their families can count on you.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct telehealth evaluations, assessments, and medication management sessions to clients located in CA.
  • Collaborate with therapists and our supervising psychiatrist to provide integrated care
  • Monitor patient outcomes and adjust treatment plans as needed
  • Participate in regular case consultations and team meetings
  • Maintain up-to-date, accurate documentation in the EMR
  • Provide psychoeducation to patients and families
  • Stay current with psychiatric care practices, telehealth trends, and CME requirements

Requirements
Essential:

  • Comfort with a high client load on busy days, with a salaried, non-per-session pay structure
  • Reliability and personal responsibility: you're consistent, follow through, and manage your time, caseload, and clinical notes without constant oversight
  • Active NP license in CA, and PMHNP certification in good standing
  • Master's or Doctoral degree in Nursing from an accredited institution

Also required:

  • Strong clinical judgment and understanding of psychiatric medications
  • Solid telehealth skills, including comfort with EMRs and virtual platforms
  • Clear, compassionate communication with patients and team members
  • Ability to work independently while staying connected to a collaborative care team
  • Commitment to delivering equitable, effective care to diverse communities

Benefits and Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Stable salary: Predictable pay regardless of session volume
  • Predictable schedule: Structured full-time hours, with an alternative Monday-Thursday option
  • Comprehensive benefits: PTO, health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a 401(k), available after a short waiting period
  • Work from home: Fully remote
  • Support for your clinical focus: Staff handle billing and scheduling, and our systems are designed not to overburden you
  • Collaborative team: Close collaboration with therapists, psychiatrists, and admin support, in a mission-driven culture of mutual respect

Ready to Apply?
If you're dedicated to your clients and want the stability of a salaried, remote PMHNP role, apply today and help us make mental health care more accessible and compassionate for all.

About Wellity Health
Wellity Health provides outpatient mental health care for Southern California and the greater bay area, with a focus on underserved populations in-person and via telehealth. As a fully remote PMHNP, you'll join that team, working closely with therapists, our supervising psychiatrist, and administrative staff who manage scheduling and billing.

Our Values and Goals
We're committed to true equity in mental health: equitable, accessible care for people from all backgrounds. Our goals are to reduce symptom severity, reduce or eliminate the need for higher levels of care, and foster lasting positive outcomes for our adolescent clients and their loved ones.

We pride ourselves on a management style and workplace culture that is respectful, understanding, and collaborative, while always prioritizing the well-being and effective treatment of our clients.

Job at a Glance

  • Location: Full-time, fully remote. Open to candidates licensed in CA, residing in CA, NM, NV, FL, or TX.
  • Pay: $165,000 - $180,000 per year, depending on experience. This is a true salary, not pay per session.
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9am - 6pm Pacific Time with a one-hour lunch. An alternative Monday-Thursday schedule is available. Remote doesn't mean "set your own schedule": our NPs work a consistent, structured weekly schedule that ensures continuity of care and team collaboration.
  • Benefits: PTO, health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a 401(k), available after a short waiting period
  • Support: Dedicated staff handle client billing and scheduling, so your time goes to clinical work.

Is this the right fit? What matters most

  1. You're comfortable with our pay and scheduling model. We pay a stable salary no matter how many sessions you conduct. In exchange, busy days can be full, so we're looking for someone who isn't afraid of a high client load and values predictable pay, a regular schedule, benefits, and the flexibility of working from home.
  2. You're reliable and dedicated to your clients. You show up fully and consistently, and our clients and their families can count on you.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct telehealth evaluations, assessments, and medication management sessions to clients located in CA.
  • Collaborate with therapists and our supervising psychiatrist to provide integrated care
  • Monitor patient outcomes and adjust treatment plans as needed
  • Participate in regular case consultations and team meetings
  • Maintain up-to-date, accurate documentation in the EMR
  • Provide psychoeducation to patients and families
  • Stay current with psychiatric care practices, telehealth trends, and CME requirements

Requirements
Essential:

  • Comfort with a high client load on busy days, with a salaried, non-per-session pay structure
  • Reliability and personal responsibility: you're consistent, follow through, and manage your time, caseload, and clinical notes without constant oversight
  • Active NP license in CA, and PMHNP certification in good standing
  • Master's or Doctoral degree in Nursing from an accredited institution

Also required:

  • Strong clinical judgment and understanding of psychiatric medications
  • Solid telehealth skills, including comfort with EMRs and virtual platforms
  • Clear, compassionate communication with patients and team members
  • Ability to work independently while staying connected to a collaborative care team
  • Commitment to delivering equitable, effective care to diverse communities

Benefits and Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Stable salary: Predictable pay regardless of session volume
  • Predictable schedule: Structured full-time hours, with an alternative Monday-Thursday option
  • Comprehensive benefits: PTO, health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and a 401(k), available after a short waiting period
  • Work from home: Fully remote
  • Support for your clinical focus: Staff handle billing and scheduling, and our systems are designed not to overburden you
  • Collaborative team: Close collaboration with therapists, psychiatrists, and admin support, in a mission-driven culture of mutual respect

Ready to Apply?
If you're dedicated to your clients and want the stability of a salaried, remote PMHNP role, apply today and help us make mental health care more accessible and compassionate for all.

raw.excerpt: About EnaraEnara is a world renowned obesity and medical weight loss start-up, based in Silicon Valley, pioneering the use of data, digital, and clinical treatments to provide personalized plans with measurable results.
raw.description:
About Enara

Enara is a world renowned obesity and medical weight loss start-up, based in Silicon Valley, pioneering the use of data, digital, and clinical treatments to provide personalized plans with measurable results. Enara was founded by people from Stanford, UCSF, Kaiser, ClassPass & Evernote. Our mission is to develop the first ever platform to scale obesity treatment. Our platform allows for the latest breakthroughs in nutrition, exercise, and obesity science to be optimized and delivered in a series of personalized and programmable experiences. Our solutions are disseminated through unified products and services we deploy for the healthcare ecosystem; with a current focus on small to medium sized medical groups and clinics. Our platform has served over 2000 members and delivers world leading 16%+ weight loss sustained over 3 years. We deliver life changing care to members and we are redesigning the clinic-patient . We are backed by , , VSC, Continuum Ventures, as well as many prominent angels in Silicon Valley.

Team Values

1. Empathy (First)- Every patient’s journey is unique, and we approach each with compassion and understanding, always treating patients with dignity.
2. Empowerment (Through Partnership) - Patients are partners in their health journey. We strive to educate, motivate, and support them at every step.
3. Respect for Diversity- We embrace and honor the unique backgrounds, cultures, and identities of every individual, fostering an environment of inclusion and understanding.
4. Innovation (for Change) - We’re committed to challenging the status quo in healthcare, advancing technology and protocols to create sustainable health outcomes.
5. Service - Heart of Service - With humility and purpose, we dedicate ourselves to serving others, putting compassion and commitment at the heart of everything we do.

The Role: A Catalyst for Vision and Execution

  • We are seeking a Senior Product Manager who operates with a unique duality. You will not only be the architect of our product vision—defining what we build—but you will also serve as a Team Catalyst for the Product and Tech organizations, defining how we execute delivery.
    • This role requires a leader who can drive execution and accountability within our squads while providing mentorship and setting the bar for product excellence. You will sit at the nexus of clinical efficacy and software delivery, ensuring that we are solving the right problems for our three core stakeholders: the Patient, the Provider, and the Administrator.

Key Responsibilities

  • 1. Delivery Catalyst & Team Accountability
    • Cultural Leadership: Act as a role model within the Product and Tech organization. Foster a culture of high accountability, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
    Process & Execution: Own the "rhythm of business" for the engineering squads. Ensure that sprints are planned effectively, blockers are removed, and velocity is maintained without sacrificing quality.
    Mentorship & Quality: Provide hands-on mentorship and support to engineering and product associates, helping the team connect their daily code to the broader clinical mission and ensuring the highest quality product delivery.
    Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the bridge between clinical operations and technology, ensuring that the "why" behind every feature is understood by the engineers building it.
  • 2. Product Vision & Clinical Execution
    • The Clinical Ecosystem: Design and manage product lifecycles that account for the complex interplay between:
    Patients: Creating engaging, empathetic interfaces that drive adherence and behavioral change.
    Providers: Building tools that reduce burnout, streamline clinical workflows, and provide actionable data at the point of care.
    Administrators: Ensuring robustness in billing, reporting, compliance, and operational efficiency.
    Roadmap Strategy: Translate high-level company goals into a prioritized roadmap. You must be ruthless in prioritization, balancing new feature innovation with technical debt and operational stability.
    Data-Driven Iteration: Define success metrics (KPIs) built around clinical outcomes and user engagement. Use data to validate hypotheses and pivot when necessary.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 6-8+ years of progressive Product Management experience, with a minimum of 4 years specifically in Digital Health or Clinical Technology.
  • US Healthcare System Insight: Required residency in the US for at least 10 years, demonstrating deep practical knowledge of US clinical payment, regulatory, and operational environments (EMR, HIPAA, provider credentialing, etc.).
  • The "Clinical" Trifecta: Proven experience shipping products that serve the distinct needs of Patients, Providers, and Administrators. You understand EMR integrations, clinical workflows, and HIPAA compliance.
  • Leadership Trajectory: Experience managing agile ceremonies and driving accountability in engineering teams. You have a track record of improving team performance and morale.
  • Technical Fluency: You don’t need to write code, but you must be able to debate technical trade-offs with engineers and understand the implications of architectural decisions.
    • - Proven experience building with AI tools (e.g., LLM integrations, prompt engineering, or AI-assisted development workflows).
    - Proficiency in no-code/low-code platforms (e.g., Zapier, Bubble, Retool, or Airtable) to build internal tools or MVPs rapidly.
  • Communication: You can speak "Doctor," "Engineer," and "Business" fluently, switching contexts without friction.
  • Language: You are bilingual and able to work in Spanish via our Chilean Engineering team.

Qualities That Will Make You Successful Here

  • Empathy: You understand that behind every data point is a patient trying to change their life and a provider trying to help them.
  • Grit: You are willing to get into the weeds to unblock a release, but you know when to pull back and look at the horizon.
  • Ownership: You take personal responsibility for the success of the product and the health of the team.
  • Proactivity: You anticipate challenges, propose solutions before problems escalate, and drive initiative across the product lifecycle.

Why Join Enara?

  • Mission-Driven: Work on a product that tangibly extends and improves human life.
  • Impact: Influence the culture and processes of a growing tech organization.
  • Growth: Opportunity to shape the future of metabolic health technology.

Cloud Operations and Engineering

Monitoring, Troubleshooting, and Diagnostics

Operational Support

Technical Development and Compliance

  • Understand end‑to‑end data flows across tolling systems, roadways data, financial transactions, and reporting tools.

  • Support optimization of integrations and data movement.

  • Apply PCI or other regulatory compliance requirements when evaluating system behavior and logging patterns.

  • Manage key vaults, passwords, certificates, and secure credential storage.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Work directly with architects, engineers, managers, and cross‑functional teams to use Azure services effectively.

  • Provide best‑practice guidance related to SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS.

  • Communicate clearly in written and verbal form with internal and external stakeholders.

Qualifications

raw.excerpt: Você é apaixonado por dados, tecnologia e agronegócio?
raw.description:
Você é apaixonado por dados, tecnologia e agronegócio?

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Cientista de Dados Pleno para integrar o time da BIP Brasil e atuar em projetos de transformação orientados por dados no setor agro.

Nesta posição, você participará do desenvolvimento de modelos analíticos e soluções baseadas em machine learning, dados geoespaciais, imagens de satélite e outras fontes de informação relevantes para o agronegócio.

Os projetos poderão envolver temas como monitoramento agrícola, previsão de produtividade, identificação de padrões, análise territorial, riscos climáticos, uso do solo, inteligência de mercado, eficiência operacional e suporte à tomada de decisão.

Na BIP, você trabalhará em um ambiente colaborativo e multidisciplinar, com profissionais de dados, tecnologia, geotecnologias, engenharia e negócio. Valorizamos a curiosidade, a autonomia, o aprendizado contínuo e a capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções pragmáticas.

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning e técnicas estatísticas aplicadas a desafios do agronegócio.
  • Analisar dados geoespaciais, agronômicos, climáticos, operacionais e de mercado.
  • Processar imagens de satélite, fotografias aéreas e outras fontes de sensoriamento remoto.
  • Desenvolver modelos para classificação, segmentação, previsão, detecção de padrões e geração de insights.
  • Criar e otimizar algoritmos de geoprocessamento para automatizar análises e tratamentos de dados.
  • Utilizar ferramentas GIS para análise, interpretação e visualização de informações espaciais.
  • Integrar dados provenientes de APIs, bancos de dados, arquivos, plataformas geoespaciais e fontes externas.
  • Estruturar processos de preparação, validação e enriquecimento de dados.
  • Apoiar a construção de indicadores, dashboards, mapas temáticos e produtos analíticos.
  • Avaliar a qualidade, o desempenho e a aplicabilidade dos modelos desenvolvidos.
  • Documentar metodologias, premissas, resultados e limitações das análises.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações com os principais resultados e recomendações.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de tecnologia, dados, especialistas de negócio e clientes.
  • Traduzir necessidades do negócio em hipóteses analíticas e soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Apoiar a implantação e a evolução de modelos em ambientes produtivos.
  • Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em ciência de dados, geoprocessamento ou análise espacial, que tenha interesse em compreender os desafios do agronegócio e desenvolver soluções conectadas às necessidades reais dos clientes.
  • Experiência anterior no setor agro será considerada um diferencial, mas não é obrigatória.
  • Formação superior completa em Ciência de Dados, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Geografia, Agronomia, Geoprocessamento ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Também consideramos profissionais de outras formações que possuam experiência compatível com os desafios da posição.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning ou análises estatísticas.
  • Conhecimento de Python ou R para tratamento de dados, modelagem e análise.
  • Conhecimento de bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com dados geoespaciais, análise espacial ou geoprocessamento.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como QGIS, ArcGIS ou plataformas equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de SQL e bancos de dados relacionais.
  • Capacidade de preparar, tratar, validar e analisar diferentes conjuntos de dados.
  • Capacidade de interpretar resultados e comunicar conclusões de maneira clara.
  • Conhecimento de métricas de avaliação e validação de modelos.
  • Facilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Capacidade de compreender problemas de negócio e transformá-los em abordagens analíticas.

Conhecimentos desejáveis

Não é necessário possuir experiência em todas as tecnologias e competências abaixo:

  • Processamento e análise de imagens de satélite ou fotografias aéreas.
  • Sensoriamento remoto e índices de vegetação.
  • Bibliotecas geoespaciais como GeoPandas, Rasterio, GDAL, Shapely ou equivalentes.
  • Google Earth Engine ou outras plataformas de processamento geoespacial.
  • Bancos de dados espaciais, como PostgreSQL e PostGIS.
  • Técnicas de deep learning e visão computacional.
  • Frameworks como TensorFlow, PyTorch ou Keras.
  • Modelos de séries temporais, previsão e detecção de anomalias.
  • Plataformas de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Microsoft Azure.
  • Databricks, Spark ou tecnologias para processamento distribuído.
  • Git e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • APIs, containers e fundamentos de implantação de modelos.
  • Ferramentas de visualização, como Power BI, Tableau, Matplotlib ou Plotly.
  • Práticas de MLOps, monitoramento e gestão do ciclo de vida de modelos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com projetos relacionados ao agronegócio.
  • Conhecimento de produção agrícola, clima, solo, culturas, operações agrícolas ou cadeias produtivas.
  • Experiência com modelos de previsão de produtividade ou monitoramento de lavouras.
  • Conhecimento de dados meteorológicos, agronômicos ou territoriais.
  • Experiência com análise de uso e cobertura do solo.
  • Conhecimento de estatística espacial e séries temporais.
  • Experiência na implantação de modelos em ambientes corporativos.
  • Cursos, especializações ou certificações em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Geoprocessamento, Sensoriamento Remoto ou Agronegócio.

Informações adicionais

CONHEÇA NOSSOS BENEFÍCIOS

Alguns dos nossos benefícios são flexíveis para que você possa distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades, interesses e momento de vida. São eles:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens);
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio para Pet;
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível e Uber, 99);

Outros benefícios:

  • Comissionamento por indicação de novos clientes.

PROGRAMAS DE DESENVOLVIMENTO

Um dos pontos fortes de ser Biper é que ousamos em pensar como empreendedores e moldamos nosso futuro com nossa capacidade de pensar minuciosamente e agir com três passos à frente, pavimentando o caminho para o futuro que nossos clientes querem viver.

Na BIP temos programas consolidados a nível Global e nacional para que você tenha uma jornada de desenvolvimento, crescimento e liberdade para você conquistar o que sonha. Aqui você é o protagonista da sua carreira!

Vamos juntos nessa? Confere os principais programas que a BIP pode te oferecer para você chegar aonde deseja:

They should be able to support students in developing effective communication and interpersonal skills, applying professional and ethical practices in school settings, and fostering student wellbeing and flourishing while preparing for successful professional placement.

Key Skills Required

  • Professional standards and ethical conduct

  • Trauma-informed pedagogy

  • Student wellbeing and flourishing

  • Effective communication

  • Interpersonal skills

  • Secondary teaching practice

  • Professional teacher identity

  • Student-centred approaches

  • School placement readiness

  • Safe and supportive learning environments

Desired Candidate Profile

  • A Doctoral qualification or Master's Degree in Teaching and/or the relevant discipline area, or equivalent accreditation and standing.

  • 5 years of relevantprimary/secondary school teaching, research and/or professional experience in the last 5 years

  • Knowledge and understanding of teacher education policies and practices.

  • Valid Teacher’s Registration in Australia (VIT Preferred), but QCT, NSW acceptable

  • Empathetic, ambitious, warm and outgoing personality willing to work closely with people from diverse cultures;

  • Proficient in English language; excellent oral and written communication

  • Must possess a working laptop and have access to high-speed (>10 MBPS) stable internet connection;

  • Ability to quickly learn and use technology platforms for interacting with students, including host university’s LMS and LINCtrac(training on these platforms will be provided).

The candidate needs to be available between 5 pm to 10 pm every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

LINC Fellows will be responsible for providing:

  1. Subject matter guidance to a group of 25-30 undergraduate online students;

  2. Support in learning skills like academic writing, research and time management;

  3. 1:1 and small group tutoring sessions;

  4. Guidance on relevant reference material;

  5. Assessment marking with long-form feedback

  6. Management of discussion forums; and

  7. Proactive, prompt and personalised support to student queries and issues.

LINC Fellows will be expected to promptly interact with students over email, or calls / online sessions from locations of their convenience (e.g. home, office etc.).

About LINC Education

LINC Education (), based in Singapore, with teams in Australia, India, the UK and the US, is a global pioneer in providing high-touch, high-quality educator-led online teaching services to globally ranked universities around the world. Our specialist services are highly sought after by university managements and faculty to retain and grow their online student enrolments. LINC’s services are customised for each university and delivered using a cutting-edge technology platform (LINCtrac) to provide a superior and effective learning experience to students. Since 2017, we have delivered online degrees on behalf of our partners to over 30,000 students across multiple disciplines with our 700+ globally located educators.

LINC is managed by education sector professionals with more than 50 years of combined experience and overseen by an advisory board of the best academic professionals in the world. Dr. Christopher Brook (Ex-Dean, Edith Cowan University and Curtin University), Dr. M Rammohan Rao (ex-Dean, Indian School of Business and ex-Director, IIM Bangalore) and Deepak Chandra (ex-Deputy Dean, Indian School of Business) are members of the LINC Board of Advisors.

In 2022,OES, Australia’s largest online education company, became one of our investors through which we joinedSEEK’s(SEK.AX) Education Portfolio

What’s on offer?

Selected applicants will be engaged as independent contractors and will be offered a competitive fixed remuneration of up to $6350 for a cohort of 25 students. Further upsides are available based on larger batch sizes as well as achievement-related increments of up to 20%.

Professional benefits include:

  • Working on behalf of globally ranked and recognised universities

  • Interacting with and learning from with high-quality university faculty;

  • Working with a diverse range of international students;

  • Specialized training for online teaching and delivery

  • Active mentoring for professional growth

  • Improving interpersonal and cross-cultural skills

The role ispart-time(15-20 hours per week) with scheduled weekend availability. Educators will have the flexibility to work from a location of their convenience.

Strong brands are built through consistent delivery of a company’s value proposition – for both its employees and its customers.

At Crump, we believe in investing in the teammates who work for us, supporting the business goals of the myriad professionals who work with us so they can best meet their clients’ needs, and bettering the communities that house our teammates. These beliefs have allowed Crump to maintain our standing as an industry top performer, not only as measured by sales results but, more importantly, by consistent customer and employee satisfaction and retention.

Job Summary

The role of the Internal Insurance Strategist (IS) is to discuss needs with and sell life, long-term care and disability income insurance to the clients and advisors of accounts supported by Crump’s Financial Institutions channel.
Candidate must have a current 6/63 Finra Registration and have Agent of Record experience. Position will be fully remote.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

  • Lead clients through discovery, including personal or business needs and goals, current financial status, be able to articulate identified gaps and opportunities, and describe solutions including life, long term care and disability income insurance to meet client needs.
  • Manage daily activities and drive sales activity and pending business.
  • Handle incoming calls directly from referral sources, and to be available for pre-set calls with clients and their Advisors.
  • Complete insurance applications and take responsibility for following cases thorough the underwriting process.
  • Explain to clients and advisors how various insurance products work, the differences between product types, and their advantages.
  • See all sales activity through towards product purchase
  • Explain the basics of estate planning, business planning, asset leveraging, insurance planning (including how to handle 1035 exchanges, explanation of insurance forms, and how to determine the need and amount of coverage).

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education, training and work-related experience
  • Minimum 2 years direct life, long-term care and disability income insurance selling experience in the field directly with clients and/or 3+ years handling inside sales helping agents sell life insurance through a General Agency or insurance carrier platform

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

  • Active Life and Health Insurance license required
  • Must possess and maintain appropriate FINRA registrations (e.g. Series 6 and 63)

FUNCTIONAL SKILLS

  • Effective interpersonal and written communication skills
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service to both internal and external customers
  • Effective time management skills
  • Ability to prioritize and accomplish multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Capable of working independently as well as in a team environment
  • Ability to work in a self-directed fashion
  • Experience with PC’s in a Windows environment
  • Demonstrated proficiency in basic computer applications such as Microsoft Office software products
  • Ability to analyze problems and develop solutions
  • Ability to communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization
  • Have a very clear grasp and understanding of all the features and functions of most term, whole life, universal life, and variable universal life products as well as long-term care and disability insurance solutions
  • Proven sales track record of hitting establish sales quotas in the insurance industry
  • Active Life and Health insurance license
  • Knowledge of the underwriting process

A comprehensive benefits package that includes PTO, medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, disability insurance, and life insurance.

About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions.Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Pennsylvania. You may also elect to spend some time working at a company office. Please note that your employment is contingent upon remaining in this location; any future requests to relocate to another state are subject to Company review and approval and may be denied based upon business need.

You Will Get To:

  • Originate and manage purchase mortgage loans from application through closing while ensuring compliance with all requirements.

  • Convert company-provided purchase opportunities into funded loans through proactive follow-up and effective borrower consultation.

  • Build strong relationships with customers and, where applicable, with Zillow Preferred Agents and local partners.

  • Manage an active pipeline while meeting defined service levels, productivity metrics, and funding expectations.

  • Leverage Zillow’s CRM, loan origination systems (LOS), and data-driven tools to manage pipeline health and customer engagement.

  • Partner with centralized processing, underwriting, and closing teams to move loans efficiently.

  • Deliver a consistent, high-quality customer experience through phone, email, and text communication.

  • Stay current on market trends, lending programs, and regulatory requirements to provide tailored financing solutions.

  • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

  • This role involves the collection, storage, and use of your voiceprints (records of speech) for operational and compliance purposes.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of mortgage origination experience with a strong emphasis on purchase transactions, either as an active NMLS Loan Originator with state licenses or as a Loan Originator under a federal bank license.

  • Completion of the 20-hour CORE Pre-Licensing Education and successful passage of the SAFE Mortgage Loan Originator Test – National Component with Uniform State Content.

  • Physically located in and working remotely from Pennsylvania.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Strong client service orientation with consultative sales skills and deep understanding of the mortgage process.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Here at Zillow, we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply if you bring transferable skills or related experience.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

diese aufgaben gehen sie mit spaß und leidenschaft an:

Vertrieb & Gebietsverantwortung

  • Sie nutzen gezielt den Vertriebsweg über die Genossenschaftsbanken und die DZ Bank und pflegen diese Partnerschaften aktiv.

das bringen sie idealerweise mit:

  • Sie sind in der Lage, Kundensituationen eigenständig zu analysieren, Factoring Lösungen zu strukturieren und Verantwortung bis zum Abschluss zu übernehmen.

  • Sie überzeugen durch unternehmerisches Denken, Überzeugungskraft und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

auf diese vorteile können sie sich freuen:

  • Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Attraktiver Dienstwagen auch zur Privatnutzung
  • Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Wege: Sie profitieren von den schnellen Entscheidungswegen in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen

  • Leasingrad: Sie können – steuerlich begünstigt - etwas Gutes für Ihre Fitness und Gesundheit tun

  • Absicherung: Unsere Unfallversicherung sichert Sie auch im Privatleben ab
  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern Sie individuell

Own Operations Analytics Strategy & Operating Model

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Metal Fabrication Estimator

Work Schedule: Work an 8-hour shift within the 7:00 AM-8:00 PM New Zealand time window, Monday to Friday.

Compensation range: $2,000 AUD - $2,300 NZD / Monthly (before tax and deductions)

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A New Zealand-based specialist metal design and fabrication company producing bespoke solutions in mild steel, stainless steel, and aluminium. The company delivers end-to-end design, engineering, and fabrication services for architectural, construction, and commercial projects across New Zealand.

Role Overview: We are seeking a Construction & Metal Fabrication Estimator. The role focuses on preparing accurate, detailed estimates for architectural metalwork, custom fabrication and specialist construction packages, covering materials, fabrication, finishing, transport and installation.

This is a hands-on estimating role requiring strong construction and fabrication knowledge, practical judgement and commercial awareness. You will work closely with experienced construction, fabrication and delivery professionals while taking increasing ownership of larger and more complex tenders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Review architectural, structural and fabrication drawings, specifications, schedules, revisions and tender documentation.
  • Prepare digital take-offs and detailed, itemised estimates covering materials, cutting, folding, welding, machining, assembly,
  • workshop labour, finishes, transport, site access, installation and subcontractors.
  • Prepare complete tender documentation, including assumptions, qualifications, exclusions, clarifications and scope breakdowns.
  • Assess buildability, installation methodology, access, sequencing, interfaces, site labour, logistics and programme constraints.
  • Identify omissions, drawing conflicts, unclear requirements, procurement issues and commercial or margin risks before submission.
  • Obtain, review and test supplier and subcontractor quotations against the required scope.
  • Work with senior stakeholders on bid strategy, value engineering and alternative solutions.
  • Maintain clear, auditable estimating workings and communicate progress, questions and uncertainty early.
  • Support accurate handover from estimating into project delivery.
  • Maintain cost libraries and pricing models, review estimate-to-actual outcomes, and improve digital, automated and AI-assisted estimating workflows.

IMPORTANT FIT FOR THE ROLE

This role requires hands-on contractor or subcontractor estimating experience for fabrication and installation packages. It is not suited to candidates whose background is primarily client-side quantity surveying, consultant cost management, budget reporting or cost planning without direct tender-pricing responsibility.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Proven estimating experience in architectural metalwork, structural or miscellaneous steel, stainless steel, aluminium, sheet
  • metal, specialist fabrication or similar subcontractor work.
  • Proven ability to prepare complete, detailed and auditable estimates, not only take-offs, budgets or cost reports.
  • Strong ability to interpret architectural, structural and fabrication drawings, specifications and revisions.
  • Practical understanding of fabrication and installation, including cutting, folding, welding, machining, finishing, assembly,
  • access, sequencing, labour and logistics.
  • Strong commercial judgement and checking discipline, with the ability to identify scope gaps, buildability concerns and tender
  • risks.
  • Strong Excel skills and excellent written and verbal English.
  • Self-directed and accountable, with the ability to manage priorities, explain estimating logic and raise concerns early.
  • Experience collaborating with project managers, designers, production teams, suppliers and subcontractors.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience pricing work in New Zealand or Australian construction markets.
  • Experience with Bluebeam Revu; PlanSwift, CostX, AutoCAD, Revit or ERP systems such as Ostendo are advantageous.
  • Experience with commercial, infrastructure, corrections, high-security or data-centre projects.
  • Interest in process automation, digital estimating and practical use of AI tools.

Tools to Use

  • Excel
  • Bluebeam Revu
  • PlanSwift
  • CostX
  • AutoCAD
  • Revit
  • ERP systems

This is a remote role that will be set up via an Employer of Record (EOR) service.

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile

raw.excerpt: About the Company Anza is a revolutionary platform that empowers solar and energy storage equipment buyers and developers to use advanced data and technology to compare more products and make confident decisions faster.
raw.description:
About the Company

Anza is a revolutionary platform that empowers solar and energy storage equipment buyers and developers to use advanced data and technology to compare more products and make confident decisions faster. The result is increased profit, reduced risk, and massive time-saving. With Anza, clients can focus on higher-value work without chasing down data or using manual tools. They can access real-time pricing and extensive technical, trade risk, counterparty, and contract term data from 95% of the U.S. module supply. Anza’s Effective $/Watt analytics enable users to evaluate modules based on production and installation costs. It provides energy storage lifecycle cost analytics across AC and DC battery systems. Anza’s vision is to help every utility-scale and DG buyer and developer make optimal design and procurement decisions.

Anza was born from internal tools at Borrego that maximized the financial value of its own projects. In 2021, Anza launched as a standalone application for broader industry use, furthering the company’s mission of accelerating the deployment of renewable energy.

At Anza, we don’t accept the status quo. We are driven by a culture of teamwork, a growth mindset and continuous improvement as we pursue our mission. Since its inception, we have surpassed our growth goals and are looking forward to continuing to build a great team and platform. We believe in having an ownership company culture, so we have implemented an attractive equity program. Join us!

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll design and build well-considered technical solutions across our full stack. You'll take ambiguous, complex requirements and turn them into shippable, maintainable software - owning features end to end from design through production.

We're a growing company in a fast-moving industry, which means priorities shift, systems evolve, and the most valuable engineers are the ones who treat that as the job rather than a disruption. You'll raise the bar for engineering quality through your code, your reviews, and your influence on how we build.

The problems are genuinely hard: helping customers instantly compare and optimize across a vast space of solar and storage products demands thoughtful architecture and careful modeling. We're cloud native (GCP), and our stack is TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL. We care deeply about developer experience and invest extensively in CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code. We expect our senior engineers to have demonstrated experience with some or all of this stack — and to be unafraid of the parts they haven't touched yet.

How We Build

We use LLMs heavily across our engineering workflows but we don't defer our thinking to the robots. The engineers who thrive here have embraced agentic engineering as a force multiplier while maintaining a deep, first-principles understanding of the code they ship. We're looking for a lead who can set that bar; someone who knows when to let the tools accelerate them and when the judgment has to be their own.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate closely with product owners, designers, QA, and other engineers to define pragmatic technical solutions within our agile process
  • Own the design, implementation, and delivery of significant features and services that solve real business challenges
  • Write high-quality, thoroughly tested code, deliver well-considered Pull Requests, and contribute to scalable, maintainable architecture
  • Champion technically sound and well-designed product decisions that meet our customers’ needs and contribute to the overall health of the platform

What You'll Bring

While no one individual will possess them all, the successful candidate will bring many of the following experiences, skills, and attributes::

  • 5+ years of hands on technical experience
  • 3+ years of Node.js and React experience (Typescript)
  • Strong knowledge of relational data modeling, API design, and software architecture
  • Experience developing cloud native applications (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • A flexible, adaptable mindset - comfortable pivoting quickly when direction or approach changes, and energized rather than intimidated by touching systems you didn't build
  • A pragmatic bias toward shipping: you weigh trade-offs, pick the solution that fits the moment, and avoid over-engineering

Compensation & Benefits

Anza uses an internally equitable and externally competitive total cash approach to compensation. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, health, life, and disability insurance; a comprehensive wellness program; 401(k) plan with company match and immediate vesting; continuing education and professional development assistance; and self-managed flexible work schedules and time-off policies.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Anza provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, Anza complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

Anza's team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. Anza does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the Anza team for a specific position. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Anza. Anza is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

10+ years of successful professional staffing sales experience, including IT, Finance and Accounting, Engineering, or other professional disciplines.

Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

Strong hunter mentality with the ability to independently develop and close new business.

Entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to thrive in a growing, fast-moving organization.

Excellent interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

Minimum Bachelor's degree.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted subject matter expert and strategic partner to emergency response agencies—guiding 911 PSAPs, dispatch directors, and municipal decision-makers toward building a resilient foundation for modern public safety operations.


As a key driver of our growth, you will lead complex sales engagements within emergency dispatch centers, navigating municipal procurement cycles and highly regulated ecosystems to help public safety organizations achieve their operational goals.


Responsibilities:

  • Quota Attainment: Achieve or exceed assigned vertical sales quota on a consistent, repeatable, and transparent basis.
  • Strategic Account Penetration: Target new logos and lead complex sales efforts to deeply penetrate strategic prospect accounts.
  • Pipeline Forecasting: Accurately forecast revenue pipelines while maintaining exceptional Salesforce hygiene and regional visibility.
  • Consultative Solution Design: Understand unique client business goals and design modern security solutions that mitigate risk exposure.
  • Public Safety Prospecting: Identify and build relationships with 911 directors, IT managers, and city/county purchasing agents.
  • Consultative Selling: Conduct deep needs assessments regarding analog-to-digital migrations and Next-Generation 911 (NG911) readiness.
  • RFP Excellence: Lead the end-to-end technical response for formal government bids, RFPs, and RFQs.
  • Ecosystem Integration: Partner with major radio (P25, RoIP) and telephony vendors (Motorola, Harris, Zetron) to position integrated solutions.
  • Live Demonstrations: Present software capabilities like incident reconstruction, screen recording, Quality Assurance (QA) evaluation, and AI speech analytics.
  • Contract Management: Secure long-term RaaS (Recording as a Service) contracts and system expansion revenue.
  • Vertical-Alignment Strategy: Operate productively and independently across the United States

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree with 1+ years of experience in sales, customer success, military and/or public safety experience
  • OR 4+ years of experience in sales, customer success, military and/or public safety experience
  • Industry Experience: 1+ years selling technology directly to public safety agencies, local governments, or municipalities preferred
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of P25 radio networks, SIP/VoIP logging, CAD (Computer-Aided Dispatch) integration, and NG911 i3 standards.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with CJIS (Criminal Justice Information Services) security policies and state-specific public record retention laws.

Location/Travel:

Job Description

Join us as Project Manager Clinical Supplies - To manage the end-to-end supply chain for clinical trials, ensure timely and efficient distribution of trial materials, maintain optimal inventory levels, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the successful execution of clinical studies.

This is a fully remote position for candidates located in the United States.

Prior clinical supplies experience in the Contract Research Organization (CRO) industry is a requirement.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop study specific plans for each assigned project.
    • Meet with internal teams to coordinate efforts, provide recommendations and risks, and update project reports/spreadsheets.
    • Integrate all clinical supplies activities into the supply chain to support project logistic strategy and compliance with GxP requirements.
    • Participate in ongoing training on new regulations.
    • Representing the department internally and externally at meetings, strategic projects and initiatives as per the business requirements.
    • Mentor and guide support junior team members.
    • Participate in process improvement initiatives.
    • Maintain and use existing tools while continuously looking for improvement opportunities.
    • May participate in the bidding and/or bid defense opportunities client contact for their supply chain requests/questions/concerns.

    Education and Experience:
    • Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
    • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).
  • CRO industry experience is a requirement.

    In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Strong English and communication skills both written and verbal
    • Strong interpersonal, planning, organizational, problem solving, sense of urgency and decision-making skills
    • Effective leadership and team building skills
    • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
    • Strong focus on customers and attention to detail
    • Ability to work in team environment, as well as work independently with little guidance
    • Good understanding of clinical supply operations
    • Solid client building and 3rd party relationship management
    • Ability to provide customer service with the highest standards of quality and excellence

    Working Conditions and Environment:
    • Work may be performed in a production, office or home-based environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
    • Occasionally travels both domestic and international

    Physical Requirements:
    • Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
    • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
    • Frequent mobility required.
    • Occasional crouching, stooping, bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
    • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
    • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
    • Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
    • Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
    • Works independently with little guidance or reliance on oral or written instructions and plans work schedules to meet goals. Requires multiple periods of intense concentration.
    • Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
    • Regular and consistent attendance.

    Why Join Us?
    When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

    Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.
