Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

The Opportunity:

The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer solves complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers. The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer works assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Essential Job Functions

  • Ability to manage big data and creating solutions for reporting requirements provided by stakeholders.

  • Problem solving and completing root cause analysis on production bugs.

  • Following standard SDLC process and agile practices within a team

  • Develop internal and external partnerships to provide opportunity for efficient solutions to various data, system and application uses.

  • Serves as a technical resource and mentor to other developers / Engineers and aids in trouble shooting and resolving issues

  • Actively review new bugs reported and complete grooming and sprint planning

  • Complete bug root cause analysis and work with other teams as needed to resolve issues and completes documentation and notification to the bug reporter at least twice per week.

  • Subject matter expert (SME) of report data modeling as well as being knowledgeable about what each field is used for and is able to determine appropriate uses of data fields to create reporting.

  • Advanced knowledge and skills for secondary tools such as Microsoft Azure, SQL data warehouse, Visual Studio, etc.

  • Has advanced programming and optimizing skills in DAX, Dax Studio, Performance Analyzer, Vertipaq, SQL and M Languages

  • Collect, organize, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy through Power BI report development.

  • Responsible for the data mining, manipulation and delivery to key stakeholders and executives in accordance with priorities and deadlines

  • Ability to form key relationships with and deliver professional, customer focused service to key stakeholders and executives.

  • Leads the evaluation of what current and future data needs are and translates needs to stakeholders and product owners to support all lines of business.

  • Leads high level discussions with a focus on making recommendation and identifying how data can support key business decisions.

  • Identifies report requirements and determine how the desired results can be achieved.

  • Responsible for developing and maintaining strategic reports out of multiple databases and systems.

  • Completing systems validation for client data which identifies discrepancies in data totals or PK’s.

  • Works with team members as mentor and provides opportunities of open collaboration to problem solve or optimize reports.

  • Practical application experience with Dax Studio and Performance Analyzer and can optimize reporting based on analysis findings.

  • Completing code review / peer review of completed work by co-developers and providing feedback identifying issues or required report updates to meet the requirements ahead of the report moving to UAT.

  • Presenting and/or publishing completed reports in accordance with publishing guidelines.

Required Experience

  • 3-5 years experience with relational databases and advanced T-SQL Experience – must have the ability to write complex, highly-optimized queries for data cleansing across large volumes of data

  • 3-5 years experience developing Power BI reports (with M, SQL, DAX language proficiency)

  • 5+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience required

  • 1+ years of knowledge and/or experience with ETL and Azure data warehouse concepts and processes (Experience with Azure Databricks is a plus.)

  • Building and maintaining API’s

  • Advanced Vertipaq, Dax Studio, Tabular editor experience

  • Advanced SQL concepts and validation review between data source and report output

  • Power Apps integration

  • Excellent communication, organizational, planning, problem solving, analytical, judgment, and research skills

  • Ability to own and resolve problems.

  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.

  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.

  • This position pays between $91,400 - $175,200 based on experience


Join an award-winning company

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.


We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Safety Technology Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Safety Technology Analyst, you will drive the strategic implementation and operational excellence of Parexel's pharmacovigilance safety technology systems. This position plays a critical role in ensuring regulatory compliance, system optimization, and the delivery of advanced safety solutions that protect patient safety and accelerate clinical research. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Safety Operations, IT, Quality Assurance, and external auditors, following industry-standard processes and regulatory frameworks. Responsibilities include designing and implementing complex technology solutions, managing system integrations, leading change management initiatives, and providing expert guidance on safety database platforms and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.


You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing patient safety, driving operational excellence, and shaping the future of clinical research technology. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Safety Technology Administrator can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research technology, regulatory compliance, and strategic system implementation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the setup, configuration, and support of Parexel's safety database and associated systems, including new study implementations, periodic and ad-hoc report generation, expedited report rule configuration, and comprehensive end-user support
  • Direct the planning and execution of safety database handovers from clients to Parexel and from Parexel to clients at project completion, ensuring seamless transitions for complex pharmacovigilance operations
  • Design and deliver complex integration solutions between Parexel safety technologies and other applications to enhance operational capabilities and drive service excellence
  • Represent Safety Technology Management in cross-functional collaboration with IT, Quality Assurance, and external auditors, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, security standards, and quality protocols
  • Lead change management initiatives aligned with Software Development Life Cycle principles, including impact assessments, testing methodologies, system validation, and software updates
  • Develop and deliver presentations and technical documentation for safety technology solutions, including authorship and review of standard operating procedures and controlled documents
  • Lead issue resolution and collaboration with Parexel IT, vendors, Safety Services staff, and clients for proper analysis and closure of technical issues across supported systems
  • Train, coach, and provide work directions to team members in system administration, database support, and strategic implementation activities
  • Collaborate with Global Pharmacovigilance Intelligence Office to ensure safety systems maintain regulatory compliance and proactively meet evolving requirements

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Advanced technical expertise in pharmacovigilance safety technology systems, including complex configurations, system administration, and application support
  • Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a client-focused approach
  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to mentor team members and represent the organization in cross-functional environments
  • Demonstrated experience in system validation, change management, and regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11, EMA Annex 11, GAMP)
  • Proficiency with standard scripting languages (SQL), Service Desk Tools, and project management methodologies
  • Knowledge of emerging pharmacovigilance technologies, including AI, with a flexible attitude toward continuous learning and new challenges
  • Deep understanding of pharmacovigilance roles, standards, practices, GVP, and GCP requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with safety supportive applications (Argus, Vault Safety, EDC, Safety ERP) across all functional areas and secondary tools
  • 5+ years of experience working closely with safety operations teams to manage issues, gather requirements, and deliver technology solutions
  • Advanced knowledge and practical application of computer system regulations and guidance (21 CFR Part 11, EMA Annex 11, GAMP)
  • Demonstrated proficiency with standard scripting languages (SQL) and industry-standard Service Desk Tools
  • Strong technical writing capability and proven ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • BA/BSc in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; master's degree preferred
  • 1+ years of direct mentorship, training, or peer oversight experience
  • Demonstrated lead participation in system/process improvement initiatives and 1+ years of system validation design and execution

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

raw.description:
Regional Investigative Reporter


A regional investigative reporter at NEWSWELL will serve a statewide California audience and support our local newsrooms with a stream of high‑impact accountability and investigative reporting.


This job is part of a new standalone investigative team that serves the Western newsrooms in NEWSWELL’s nonprofit collective.


This experienced reporter will focus on investigative reporting that emanates from ongoing news in our local sites or on unique regional or statewide reporting that can be of service to our local audiences.


The team’s work may focus on a core topic area including:

  • housing and income disparity
  • urban policy and disruption
  • health care and health disparity
  • agriculture and immigration
  • education and child development
  • technology influence and malfeasance
  • criminal justice and rule of law

This reporter has the skills to originate, scope and execute sophisticated accountability projects that examine how power, money, decisions and public systems shape life across California and the West.


This reporter will use advanced reporting techniques — complex public records work, deep sourcing, data analysis and document‑driven research — and help elevate investigative standards across the team and our local newsrooms. This reporter/editor demonstrates skill at mentoring colleagues and collaborating on digital presentation, packaging and impact tracking.


This reporter may collaborate with the team’s senior statewide reporter, other team members and staffers from NEWSWELL’s local newsrooms, and should bring a mentorship sensibility to the role.

Every piece of our team’s work will focus on two equal priorities: impact and audience connection:


IMPACT: All our efforts should pursue righting a wrong and demonstrating the power of journalism to improve public life.


AUDIENCE CONNECTION: Everything we publish should also be in pursuit of strengthening audience ties to our newsroom, through two-way dialogue, public events, uses of new platforms or other methods to demonstrate public outreach.


NEWSWELL helps newsrooms become nonprofit and for-community, providing strategic guidance, innovative solutions and operational support so journalists can focus on what matters most: serving their communities. Through partnerships with Arizona State University — named the nation’s most innovative university for 11 years in a row — NEWSWELL brings cutting-edge ideas, research and tools to reinvent local news and strengthen democracy.


Our innovative model has earned us support from journalistic and philanthropic organizations nationwide. This new team’s work is designed to leverage and grow that support, so that we can grow and transform local journalism.


Submission Requirements

A cover letter explaining the key contributions you would bring to the role and explaining how your clips shed light on the path to that role.


A resume explaining your professional skills and background.


At least three clips demonstrating aptitude for investigative impact and audience connection.



The pay rate for this role is $70,000-$80,000 annually.



What you’ll do

  • Conceive, develop and produce original investigative and accountability stories that deliver exclusive findings, reveal systemic issues or influence and have measurable civic impact.
  • Mentor and coach local newsrooms and collaborate on local reporting.
  • Integrate solutions journalism, audience interaction and other innovative techniques into the investigative workflow.
  • Execute complex public records reporting.
  • Analyze data at an advanced level or collaborate with others to do so.
  • Develop and protect sensitive sources across government, institutions and communities.
  • Travel as needed to NEWSWELL locations and other reporting locations.
  • Collaborate with editors and the impact producer to present stories to a broad range of audiences.
  • Use multiple digital publishing formats when appropriate.
  • Represent the newsroom at community forums and partner events; engage transparently with readers and stakeholders.
  • Pilot new tools, including responsible AI, to enhance research, document analysis and workflow efficiency.
  • Partner with ASU’s Walter Cronkite School and other academic institutions to create strong student engagement opportunities, including reporting, learning experiences and newsroom collaboration.
  • Contribute to an inclusive, collaborative newsroom culture that values transparency, fairness, equity and community impact.

What you'll need

Investigative mastery: FOIA/OMA strategy, document analysis, source development, meticulous verification.

  • Solutions journalism practice: familiarity with evidence standards, comparative case vetting and transparent limitations; ability to integrate solutions frames without advocacy.
  • Storytelling excellence: ability to distill complex information; strong organization and project management across multi‑month investigations and faster accountability hits.
  • Digital fluency: SEO‑aware writing, smart packaging, social and audience collaboration to maximize reach and comprehension.
  • Risk awareness: strong judgment around legal, safety and trauma‑informed practices.
  • Mentorship: strong sense of collaboration with fellow reporters and other staffers.
  • Proficiency in Associated Press style; commitment to fairness, accuracy, inclusion and community‑centered journalism.

Relevant qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in journalism or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five years of journalism experience with a record of accountability or investigative work.
  • Demonstrable experience producing exclusive findings, document‑driven reporting, public records work and data‑enhanced stories.

Preferred education and experience

  • Data reporting: spreadsheet manipulation, dataset cleaning, identifying trends; collaborate on charts/maps/visuals.
  • Experience in visual production, shooting or producing your own images, video, social media content or work on other platforms beyond written stories.
  • Experience reporting in California and the West.
  • Experience with cross‑newsroom or regional accountability collaborations.

Preferred skills and abilities

  • Advanced data tools (SQL, R or Python) or mapping software (ArcGIS, QGIS).
  • Fluency in languages other than English.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with matching employer contribution
  • 22 days of vacation time
  • 11 holidays, including your birthday
  • Parental leave
  • Significant tuition reductions
  • Professional development is highly valued at ASU Enterprise Partners, where employees are encouraged to look across the organization and nurture new areas of interest
  • $30 bi-weekly cell phone reimbursement

NEWSWELL is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title

Senior Fabric Engineer

Position Location

Remote – work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

AI2IO recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Senior Fabric Engineer leads the architecture and hands-on build of AI2IO’s next-generation enterprise data platform on Microsoft Fabric. Reporting into the Business Intelligence function, this role is responsible for designing and implementing a governed Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) lakehouse architecture that consolidates data from Deltek Vantagepoint, project performance systems, HRIS, and financial systems into a single, trustworthy foundation for reporting, forecasting, and future AI-enabled analytics.

This is a deeply technical, builder-focused role. The Senior Fabric Engineer partners closely with the Director of Business

Intelligence and a Data Analyst to translate validated business definitions and source-system lineage into a well-modeled,

performant, and maintainable data platform — including ingestion pipelines, Delta Lake table design, dimensional modeling,

and the deployment standards that keep the platform reliable as it scales.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience standing up or significantly modernizing an enterprise data warehouse on the Microsoft data stack, is comfortable working from imperfect or undocumented legacy source systems, and takes pride in building a platform other people can trust.

Essential Functions

Platform Architecture & Implementation

  • Design and Build the Fabric Lakehouse: Architect and implement the Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) layer structure in Microsoft Fabric, including Delta Lake table design, partitioning strategy, and performance optimization
  • Own Data Ingestion & Integration: Design and build ingestion pipelines from source systems — including Deltek
  • Vantagepoint, Power BI semantic models, project performance data, and financial/HRIS systems — into the Bronze layer, with appropriate error handling and monitoring
  • Establish the Dimensional Model: Design and build a proper dimensional (Dim/Fact) model in the Silver/Gold layers that replaces ad hoc, view-on-view logic with clean, conformed dimensions and auditable fact tables
  • Set Deployment Standards: Define and implement CI/CD, version control, environment promotion, and release standards for the data platform in partnership with the BI operating model and Azure DevOps backlog

Platform Engineering & Reliability

  • Ensure Data Quality at the Source: Build validation, reconciliation, and monitoring into ingestion and transformation pipelines so that data quality issues are caught before they reach reporting layers
  • Optimize for Scale and Cost: Monitor and tune Fabric capacity usage, pipeline performance, and storage costs as the platform grows in scope and usage
  • Document the Platform: Maintain clear technical documentation of pipeline logic, table schemas, and lineage from source system through to the Gold layer, in support of the broader KPI certification and governance effort

Partnership & Delivery

  • Partner with the Data Analyst: Translate validated business requirements, KPI definitions, and source-data findings from the Data Analyst into concrete platform design decisions
  • Support Governance: Work with the Director of Business Intelligence and the KPI Governance Council to ensure the platform enforces, rather than works around, agreed-upon metric definitions
  • Enable Forecasting & AI Enablement: Build the platform foundation needed to support enterprise revenue and IT forecasting initiatives, and future AI-assisted reporting and data Q&A capabilities

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

  • Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, and Delta Lake, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture patterns
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing dimensional (Dim/Fact) data models for enterprise reporting
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with SQL Server, including reading and reverse-engineering complex, layered legacy views
  • Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines from ERP, financial, or project-based systems (experience with Deltek Vantagepoint or similar professional services ERP systems is a plus)
  • Working knowledge of Power BI semantic models and DAX sufficient to collaborate effectively with BI/analytics stakeholders
  • Experience establishing deployment, version control, and release standards for data platforms, ideally using Azure DevOps
  • Ability to work independently from ambiguous or incomplete requirements, and to raise data quality or governance concerns proactively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical decisions clearly for a non-engineering audience
  • Demonstrated aptitude for learning new technology and adapting to evolving requirements

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related discipline

PLUS

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform roles, including hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake, or comparable modern lakehouse platforms
  • Experience working on an enterprise data warehouse or BI modernization initiative, ideally within a professional services, project-based, or similarly complex operating environment

Benefits

AI2IO offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is AI2IO's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

AI2IO is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

raw.description:
Job Overview:

The primary responsibility of the ROC – M/LWD is to monitor the DS jobs utilizing his/her skills, experience, and available ROC hardware and software resources. The ROC – M/LWD is the first point of contact, for M/LWD technical support, for the field personnel. The ROC – M/LWD should timely identify the job-related risks and hazards; and intervene to prevent equipment failures and non-productive time. The ROC – M/LWD shall seek the Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for complex and critical problems to provide an adequate and timely solution. Follows the corresponding steps of the Drilling Engineering process.

Responsibilities:

  • Must know and comply with the ROC Standard and approved local Appendices.
  • Follow the drilling engineering “Rules to live by”.
  • Comply with standards, internal processes, drilling instructions and operational procedures during the job planning and execution phases.
  • Establish and maintain constant communication with in-line management.
  • Participate in all ROC pre-job meetings.
  • Ensure remote-control application screens are connected or ready to be connected. (in situations of low field bandwidth) (TV lagging Field System).
  • Utilize the relevant job experience in troubleshooting any change in scope operations.
  • In case of the incident the ROC M/LWD must follow approved local incident/ event management process and establish the communication with management. The local incident / event management (OEPS Document – ROC Event Management Process) shall comply with ROC standard. If local incident / event management process is not established, follow the RTOC Standard (2.3.2 Incident Management Process).
  • Follow approved intervention process to provide the assistance with operations when required.
  • The ROC M/LWD has the full authority to STOP the job if current rig operation leads to Quality or HSE incidents.
  • Should perform pre-run paperwork / programming verification. The Field Engineers to submit to ROC M/LWD on duty pre-run programming for all runs to be QC’d by RTOC.
  • Shall validate the proper GeoMag Reference Input in Spectrum Navigator for each MWD run.
  • Perform TFO Spectrum verification.
  • The ROC M/LWD must establish the communication with M/LWD at the rig site and provide the verbal or written confirmation on TFO value and TFO measurement procedure before running the BHA below the rotary table. The Field Engineers must submit the necessary pre-run TFO paperwork to ROC M/LWD on tour. FOM to be included on insufficient submission email reply.
  • Monitor all jobs in the Geozone in real time via approved remote-control application, WITSML streaming and /or WITSML LWD submissions. The designated high-profile jobs require closer attention to ensure the rig crew follows the proper procedures and instructions. In instance of high-profile / high-complexity jobs the well data access is requested from RTDS and the field crew is required to enable WTSML communication/ streaming. If the direct WITSML data streaming is not available, third party EDR (Electronic Data Recorder) access to be requested with appropriate mnemonics for WITSML data streaming.
  • Deliver a quick update reports on rig related issue to relevant personnel.
  • The update report to include Out of Specification (OOS) conditions encountered / mitigation employed / troubleshooting attempted / component issue. (directional drilling, hydraulics, controller etc.).
  • Responsible for ensuring that operational specifications (limits) of the downhole DD/LWD tools are not exceeded.
  • Quality Check CORE submission and upload to Reliability. The Field Engineers to submit CORE files post-run and post-well to ROC M/LWD on tower. Any insufficient CORE submissions to be sent back to field and FOM / PLM to be included.
  • The JAR file generation is not direct responsibility of ROC M/LWD. The ROC M/LWD should help with JAR file generation when possible and doesn’t interfere with direct responsibilities. JAR files to be initially completed by FOM as per job call out / load out. Field Engineers to submit to FOM any requests for JAR files while job is ongoing.
  • Field Email Submission Integrity – ROC M/LWD to ensure compliance with field submission emails. (ex. Subject nomenclature)
  • In conjunction with Technical Alerts the RTOC M/LWD to be central point in collecting/ uploading all required failure submissions and posting to designated database in correct format. Any issues with gathering information to be brought to FOM’s attention via email.
  • Proactively support the field personnel to ensure that operational specifications (limits) of the downhole M/LWD tools are not exceeded.
  • Conduct RTOC self-audits in their districts, report findings to the ROC Manager, and actively follow up to complete audit’s corrective actions.
  • Perform various duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.
  • Demonstrate a personal commitment to Quality, Health, Safety and the Environment:
    • Maintain a safe and healthy workplace for all employees
    • Enforce all safety precautions and practices
    • Promote the safe work practices
    • Always attend a mandatory safety meeting and maintain Company property and equipment in safe operating conditions
  • Know and understand Weatherford’s Enterprise Excellence Process and the Quality Policy and comply with all requirements of the Quality Systems Manual, Operating and Technical Procedures and Workplace Instructions.
  • Must understand and comply with all safety rules and company policies of Weatherford.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in M/LWD operations
  • Thorough knowledge of Drilling Systems products and services
  • Bachelor’s degree in oil and gas related technical discipline – Electrical, Instrumentation, Petroleum Engineering
  • English proficiency at advanced level

Skills:

  • Demonstrate the knowledge of anti-collision analysis
  • Experience and ability to solve problems and perform with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to use multiple sources of data to formulate, test, and verify failure modes in M/LWD and relative surface equipment
  • Familiarity with the different forms of vibration encountered while drilling
  • Complete the Measurement Academy class -certificate, level
  • Have sufficient experience with M/LWD tools used in Geozone to provide adequate technical support to field personnel.
  • Submit the Valid AC101 certificate
  • Competent with Microsoft Office
  • Basic skills of the latest Weatherford software necessary to perform daily tasks
  • Excellent communication, organization, troubleshooting and teamwork skills. Positive attitude and a high degree of self-discipline and motivation
  • Able to relate to rig-site personnel at all levels.
  • Experiences with Rotary Steerable tools / Mud Motors

raw.description:
About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

Vasion is hiring a Solutions Architect for our regulated and federal business, where the hardest technical problems in our portfolio live. You will be the person who owns the defensible technical answer when a federal customer asks whether something can work inside their authentication, network isolation, and accreditation constraints, and who defines the path forward when the standard answer does not apply.

This is a depth role rather than a breadth role. Architectural fluency without current, detailed product knowledge does not survive contact with a regulated deployment, so we are looking for someone who goes deep on the product and stays there as the portfolio evolves.

What you'll do
  • Build depth on new capabilities ahead of demand: Reach working depth on newly released capability before customers force the question, surfacing integration gaps and unsupported edge cases while they can still be addressed.
  • Be the technical authority on federal and regulated requirements: Own the answer on whether our architecture meets a customer's authentication, authorization, and accreditation requirements, and clearly state where current product capability ends.
  • Codify the patterns that keep recurring: Turn the most complex recurring problems into reusable reference designs, so future engagements inherit proven solutions rather than rediscovering them.
  • Assess technical risk and manage it: Evaluate risk posture, architecture constraints, and deployment feasibility on the highest-complexity opportunities, then define the mitigations, sequencing, or architectural changes that make the solution deployable.
  • Design beyond the standard template: Define architecture, integration points, and cutover approach for environments that exceed what standard delivery patterns cover.
  • Protect context across the handoff: Supply the technical assumptions, constraints, integration points, and success criteria into joint technical kickoffs, so nothing essential is lost between the deal team and delivery.
  • Execute the hardest cutovers: Take the customer environment through cutover where complexity exceeds what standard delivery supports, rather than handing a design over and stepping away.
  • Diagnose root cause on escalations: Supply the definitive technical diagnosis when a deployment stalls or a production issue surfaces, separating root cause from reported symptom.
  • Convert friction into fixes: Classify what you encounter by root cause, then drive recurring patterns into product input, service offerings, or enablement with named owners, so the same problem does not return to you a third time.
Qualifications
  • Deep enterprise deployment experience: Eight or more years deploying infrastructure software into complex enterprise or public sector environments, with clear ownership of outcomes rather than handoffs.
  • Identity and authentication depth: Strong working command of SAML, SSO, directory integration, certificate-based authentication, and common identity providers.
  • Networking fundamentals under pressure: DNS, TLS and certificate chains, firewalls, proxies, VLANs, and the ability to isolate a problem in a network you did not design and cannot fully see.
  • Hyperscale, virtualization, and appliance platforms: Practical command of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP, or comparable hyperscalers), virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable), and virtual appliance deployment, sizing, and troubleshooting.
  • Linux administration and scripting: Comfortable at the command line, reading logs, and automating with PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
  • Demonstrated learning velocity: Evidence of acquiring new technical domains to real depth, since this portfolio will expand under you.
  • Customer-facing composure: Proven ability to hold a technical conversation with a frustrated customer under real pressure, and to keep it factual and forward-moving.
  • Judgment about what generalizes: A track record of turning one-off solutions into reusable assets rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Public sector deployment experience: Direct work with PIV and CAC authentication, FedRAMP authorized environments, DoD networks, or government cloud regions.
  • Print infrastructure or output management background: Experience with enterprise print management, print protocols, or document output platforms.
  • Workflow automation platforms: Exposure to document workflow, process automation, or integration platforms.
  • Other regulated industry experience: Healthcare, financial services, or comparable environments with badge-based authentication, strict change control, or audit-driven constraints.
  • Cloud and endpoint breadth: Azure, AWS, or GCP, plus VDI platforms and endpoint management tooling.
  • Agentic AI acumen
Benefits
  • Flexible work environment
  • Vacation Bonus
  • Flexible paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Competitive pay
  • A full suite of traditional benefits
  • Training/Advancement opportunities
  • 401k with company match and immediate vesting
  • Financial wellness education
  • Company-contributed HSA
  • On-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks & drinks, arcade, theater room, etc.
Our Core Values

Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become:

  • Disruptive Visionaries: Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers.
  • Relationship Builders: We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication.
  • Candor Seekers: Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly.
  • Action Owners: Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance.
More about Vasion

Visit to learn more about Vasion.

Additional Information

Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.

Role Title: Pediatric Hospitalist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Pediatric Hospitalist Physicians to contribute their medical expertise to a customer project focused on inpatient care and documentation standards. In this role, you’ll apply your pediatric clinical training to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review medical records, including FHIR data and clinical notes, for AI training.
  2. Check whether clinical information and claims are supported by the medical record.
  3. Review inpatient pediatric documentation, including HPI, PMH, birth and developmental history, immunization status, assessments, and plans.
  4. Follow clear guidelines and apply the same standards consistently.
  5. Identify missing, incorrect, or inconsistent information in medical records, including weight-based dosing and age-appropriate clinical details.
  6. Share feedback to help improve AI models and data quality.
  7. Communicate clearly with the project team about your work and findings.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. At least 5 years of hospitalist experience.
  2. MD or DO, board certified in Pediatrics (or Pediatrics with a Pediatric Hospital Medicine subspecialty certification).
  3. Current or recent inpatient pediatric hospitalist experience (within the last 2 years).
  4. Strong understanding of inpatient documentation and hospital workflows, including admission, daily progress notes, transitions of care, and discharge.
  5. Comfortable reviewing clinical notes and raw medical record data.
  6. Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clear guidelines consistently.
  7. Experience with chart review, clinical documentation improvement, utilization review, or medical coding/QA is a plus.
  8. Experience across a broad pediatric patient mix, such as general pediatrics, newborn/nursery care, pediatric subspecialty co-management, or complex chronic conditions, is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

The Supplier Quality Engineer - Technical Specialist concentrates his/her product specific quality and technical skills to develop complex suppliers and products that can meet customer requirements; requires strong partnerships with the external supply base, with supply chain teams and with engineering to achieve results

Build strong relationships with all critical partners to improve quality and business outcomes, including: external suppliers, external customers, and internal customers and stakeholders, such as Purchasing, Manufacturing and Engineering; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to strengthen the soft skills required to develop effective relationships. Support the cross-functional development of external supply base strategies and the cross-functional supplier selection process for any given component; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products. Conduct external supplier audits in support of supplier risk mitigation, supplier readiness, and supplier performance improvement; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to improve auditing effectiveness. Lead increasingly complex quality improvement plans within the external supply base in order to improve supplier performance. Ensure resolution of increasingly complex external supplier related quality challenges, by leading root cause analysis, by supporting development of corrective actions and by verifying the effectiveness of corrective actions; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of problem resolution.

raw.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

As the Senior Director, Media Strategy & Excellence, you are accountable for setting and leading the enterprise media strategy across Patient and HCP audiences, brands, indications, and lifecycle stages. You will establish how argenx uses media to connect customer needs and journeys with brand strategy, accelerate launch and growth priorities, and create relevant, measurable experiences across paid and emerging channels.

You will partner closely with the Vice President, Patient Experience; Brand and Indication Leads across Patient and HCP Marketing; Digital; Insights & Analytics; Customer Experience/CRM; Market Access; and agency partners to develop integrated media strategies that maximize the impact of argenx investments and strengthen the connection between media, customer engagement and commercial performance.

This role will establish the strategic direction, standards, operating practices and capabilities required to build media excellence across the organization. The Media Strategy & Excellence Lead will guide portfolio-level media decisions, agency and partner performance, measurement and optimization, audience strategy, data and technology enablement, and innovation across an evolving media landscape.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Media strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Set and lead the enterprise media strategy across Patient and HCP audiences, current and future brands, indications, and assets.
  • Translate enterprise, customer experience, brand and indication priorities into clear media strategies that advance customer engagement, launch readiness, brand performance, and patient impact.
  • Establish a portfolio-level view of media opportunities, customer needs, audience behaviors, channel dynamics, and investment priorities across argenx.
  • Guide media planning across the customer journey, from disease education and pre-launch engagement through branded activation, conversion, and ongoing customer engagement.
  • Set strategic principles and standards for how media is planned, activated, measured and optimized across the organization.
  • Partner with Brand and Indication Leads to determine the appropriate role of media within broader customer engagement and omnichannel strategies.
  • Guide investment choices and trade-offs across audiences, brands, indications, lifecycle stages, and channels to maximize portfolio impact.
  • Ensure media strategies reflect the distinct needs of individual brands and indications while identifying opportunities to create greater consistency, scale, and efficiency across the portfolio.
  • Bring a forward-looking media perspective into strategic planning, launch planning, and resource allocation discussions.
  • Serve as a senior advisor to the Vice President, Patient Experience and other Commercial leaders on media strategy, investment, performance, and emerging opportunities.

Integrated media planning, activation, and performance

  • Lead the development of integrated media strategies that connect Patient and HCP audience needs, customer journeys, brand objectives, creative strategy, channel roles, and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Brand, Patient Experience, HCP Experience, Digital, CRM and other teams to ensure media is integrated into broader customer engagement strategies rather than operating as a standalone channel.
  • Establish audience-first planning approaches that use customer insights, segmentation, and behavioral signals to guide media strategy and activation.
  • Guide the appropriate mix of channels and platforms across traditional, digital, programmatic, streaming, search, social, endemic, point-of-care, and emerging media environments.
  • Lead media strategy across pre-launch, launch, growth and lifecycle phases, adapting investment and engagement approaches based on business needs and in-market performance.
  • Establish clear media KPIs, measurement frameworks, and performance expectations linked to customer and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Insights & Analytics and agency teams to translate media performance into actionable insights that strengthen brand strategy, customer engagement, and future investment decisions.
  • Establish disciplined performance-review and optimization practices that enable timely decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure media insights are translated into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations for Brand, Indication, and senior Commercial leaders.
  • Partner with Digital and Analytics teams to ensure the media data, technology and measurement ecosystem supports effective activation, optimization, and performance evaluation.

Cross-functional, agency and ecosystem leadership

  • Serve as the senior media leader across the Commercial organization, bringing an integrated portfolio and customer perspective into planning and decision-making.
  • Build strong partnerships with Patient Experience, HCP Experience, Brand and Indication Leads, Digital, Insights & Analytics, CRM, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Procurement, and other relevant teams.
  • Lead the strategic relationship with media agencies and key external partners, establishing clear expectations for strategic quality, innovation, performance, transparency, and accountability.
  • Ensure agencies operate as strategic extensions of the argenx team while maintaining clear internal ownership of media strategy, data, and investment decisions.
  • Create effective ways of working across brand teams, shared capabilities, agencies, and external partners to improve planning, decision-making, and execution.
  • Partner with Procurement and Commercial leadership to ensure media investments and agency relationships deliver strong business value.
  • Identify opportunities to scale media best practices, shared approaches, and capabilities across brands, indications, and customer audiences.
  • Resolve cross-brand and cross-functional media priorities and trade-offs where enterprise or portfolio coordination is required.
  • Represent media strategy in relevant internal planning and leadership forums and with external strategic partners.
  • Model collaborative, agile, and non-hierarchical ways of working while maintaining clear accountability for media outcomes.

Media capability building and innovation

  • Define and advance the capabilities required to build a modern, high-performing media organization within argenx.
  • Establish enterprise media standards, frameworks, tools, and ways of working that improve strategic consistency while allowing teams to flex based on customer, brand, and market needs.
  • Build organizational understanding of audience strategy, channel roles, media performance, measurement, and optimization.
  • Maintain a forward-looking perspective on changes in customer behavior, media platforms, search, privacy, identity, data, technology, and regulation that may impact argenx media strategy.
  • Evaluate emerging media platforms, technologies, and partnerships and determine where innovation can create meaningful customer or business value.
  • Guide the responsible use of AI and automation to strengthen media planning, activation, optimization, measurement, and scalability.
  • Shape argenx's evolving approach to search discovery, including the implications of AI-powered search and emerging AEO/GEO environments for patient and HCP engagement.
  • Partner with Digital, Analytics, Legal, Privacy, and agency teams to ensure media capabilities evolve in a compliant, scalable, and future-ready manner.
  • Develop media talent and strengthen strategic media capabilities across internal teams and agency partners.
  • Foster a culture of customer-centricity, accountability, experimentation, learning, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Deep understanding of media strategy, planning, activation and performance across Patient/DTC and HCP audiences within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or similarly regulated healthcare environments.
  • Ability to develop enterprise and portfolio-level media strategies spanning multiple brands, indications, customer segments, and lifecycle stages.
  • Strong understanding of customer journeys, audience segmentation, omnichannel engagement, and the role media plays within an integrated customer experience.
  • Strategic understanding of the full media ecosystem, including traditional, digital, programmatic, search, social, streaming, endemic, point-of-care, and emerging channels.
  • Strong understanding of media investment strategy, portfolio prioritization, and the ability to make informed trade-offs across audiences, brands, and channels.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business, brand, and customer objectives into clear media strategies, investment priorities, and measurable performance expectations.
  • Strong analytical orientation and ability to use customer insights, media performance data, and business outcomes to inform decision-making and optimization.
  • Understanding of modern healthcare media data, identity, privacy, and measurement approaches and how they enable compliant audience activation and performance evaluation.
  • Ability to evaluate emerging technologies, AI-enabled capabilities, and evolving media platforms through both a customer-value and business-impact lens.
  • Strong agency and partner leadership skills, with the ability to set direction, challenge thinking, and create accountability across complex external ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead in a matrix environment, influence senior stakeholders, and align teams around shared priorities without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex media, data, and performance topics into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Ability to balance enterprise consistency and scale with the unique needs of individual brands, indications, and customer audiences.
  • Strong judgment and understanding of the regulatory, privacy, and compliance considerations associated with media and healthcare customer engagement.
  • Flexible to travel based on business needs.

Education, Experience and Qualifications:

  • BA/BS required; advanced degree in marketing, business, communications, analytics or a related field preferred.
  • Seasoned media and marketing leader with approximately 12–15+ years of relevant experience, including significant experience within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare.
  • Significant experience leading media strategy across both Patient/DTC and HCP audiences strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated media strategies across multiple brands, indications, customer segments, channels, or lifecycle stages.
  • Experience supporting product launches, pre-launch disease education, brand growth, and lifecycle management within complex or specialty markets.
  • Strong experience with audience-first planning, omnichannel engagement, media measurement, and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing significant media investments and making strategic allocation decisions across channels, audiences and business priorities.
  • Track record of successfully leading media agencies, technology partners, and other external partners.
  • Experience partnering across Brand Marketing, Patient Experience, HCP Marketing, Digital, CRM, Insights & Analytics, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and Procurement.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare media data, measurement, audience activation, privacy, and evolving digital ecosystem requirements.
  • Experience identifying and scaling new media capabilities, technologies, platforms, or ways of working.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and influence senior leaders in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Experience developing talent and building organizational capability through growth, ambiguity, and change.
  • Experience working in a rapidly scaling or evolving organization preferred.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Opportunity
Abbott’s Customer & Digital Experience (CDX) team is responsible for defining, driving, and delivering innovative, immersive, memorable customer-centric journeys for all our customers, across all channels (digital and physical). These journeys are grouped by Customer Types (e.g., Patient, Provider) and further categorized into a set of Experiences (e.g., Understand Risks & Complete Screening, Confirm Diagnosis). Each Experience has a set of specific, measurable Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) that the overall team is accountable to fulfill.
The Senior Content Strategist is responsible for working with a team of CDX researchers, UX designers, strategists, and copywriters to create and drive an end-to-end content solution and optimization. Their duties include collaborating with the CDX Research team to learn about current content trends and target audiences, participating in meetings with management and team members to identify business objectives and learn more about company products, analyzing and synthesizing information, and creating strategies to meet those objectives within a given time frame. They will help drive the content vision and strategy and deliver intuitive, simple, and thoughtful content strategies that guides a user through the experience. They strive to balance quantitative and qualitative feedback while maintaining empathy and keeping the user at the center of everything they create.
They can share a portfolio of work that demonstrates an ability to communicate complex ideas and terminology through simple, engaging content experiences (hierarchies, content relationships, types, metadata and schemas). They have experience collaborating with key stakeholders and legal reviewers. They are confident leading work and collaborating with writers outside of their team.

What You’ll Work On
Include, but not limited to, the following:

  • Work with the product, UX, legal review, and delivery teams to produce insightful content strategy plans, taxonomies, tagging strategies, content maps/matrices, and shepherding content through the governance processes.
  • Researching and staying up to date on the latest developments in terms of search engine optimization, content trends and consumer behavior.
  • Ensuring quality and consistency across content.
  • Support the writing, edit, testing, and improvement of content that makes our products and experiences easier to use across Abbott products and experiences.
  • Auditing experiences to help understand and assess the content and be able to provide strategic recommendations for moving forward.
  • Facilitate the collaborate and influence design decisions with multiple team members, including product, UX, development, copywriting, and key stakeholders.

    Create process and policy documents including governance guides.
  • Facilitate design sessions, ideation of product, design reviews, and appropriate sprint ceremonies and processes.
  • Understand and prioritize problems, opportunities, and solutions that contribute to the product roadmap, strategy, and vision leveraging data, research, industry trends, and BU objectives.
  • Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
  • Ability to effectively manage legal reviews and feedback cycles.
  • Travel Requirements: Ability to travel 5-10% of working time away from work location, may include overnight/weekend travel.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field of study; or High School Degree/General Education Diploma and 4+ years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties in lieu of Bachelor’s degree.

Zirtual is a work-life balanced company that provides clients with experienced, highly skilled remote assistants for both personal and professional needs. Our Executive Assistants are committed to delivering efficient, proactive, and high-quality support that meets and exceeds client expectations.

The Executive Assistant is a vital member of the Zirtual team and serves as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. In this role, you will work independently while receiving support from an Account Supervisor, who will assist with client relationships, plan adjustments, quality feedback, and ongoing guidance.

As an Executive Assistant, you will play a critical role in supporting busy professionals by managing schedules, communications, and day-to-day operations. You will help streamline workflows, anticipate needs, and ensure tasks are completed efficiently and accurately.

Assistants are expected to be available for clients during business hours as agreed upon with each client but around-the-clock availability is not expected. Responsibilities also include sending weekly usage reports, responding to communication within a two-hour window, maintaining detailed client profiles, and following Zirtual’s best practices for success.

This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Typical Duties and Responsibilities (may vary based on client needs)

Calendar & Schedule Management

  • Manage and coordinate complex calendars and appointments
  • Schedule meetings, calls, and events across multiple time zones
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts and proactively resolve them

Email & Communication Management

  • Monitor and manage inboxes, including drafting and responding to emails
  • Prioritize communications and ensure timely follow-up
  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal/external contacts

Administrative Support

  • Prepare documents, presentations, and reports
  • Handle data entry, file organization, and record maintenance
  • Assist with project coordination and task tracking

Travel & Event Coordination

  • Research and book travel arrangements (flights, hotels, transportation)
  • Create detailed itineraries and manage travel changes
  • Coordinate virtual and in-person meetings or events

Operations & Task Management

  • Support day-to-day business operations
  • Conduct research and compile information as needed
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency

Requirements

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Preferred

  • Bilingual (English/French and/or Spanish)
  • Experience supporting executives, entrepreneurs, or small business owners

Qualifications

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 2–4+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, or similar role
  • Experience supporting multiple clients or executives preferred
  • Typing ability of at least 50 WPM with accuracy

Technical Skills

  • Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office
  • Calendar management tools (Google Calendar, Outlook)
  • Project management and CRM tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, ClickUp, Zoho, Salesforce)
  • Communication tools (Slack, Zoom, Teams)

Work Requirements

  • Reliable high-speed internet, computer, and phone
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism
  • Availability during business hours (PST or EST, Monday–Friday), unless otherwise agreed in writing with each client
  • This independent contractor opportunity is currently available only to individuals residing in the United States or Canada.

Compensation

This is an independent contractor position. Compensation is based on a percentage of client monthly plans, with average monthly earnings ranging from $1,500–$3,800, depending on client mix.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Zirtual is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Zirtual representatives and offer job seekers false interviews or job offers. These scams often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Zirtual will never ask for payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
  • No Equipment: Zirtual does not provide equipment and does not request candidates to pay for equipment.
  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Zirtual: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @zirtual.com address.
  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @zirtual.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Zirtual, please report it immediately to . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux.

HABILIDADE:

Windows e Linux.

· Conhecimento básico em conceitos de segurança da informação para garantir a integridade e segurança dos ativos

monitorados.
